schinese.CardLore_4000: 马格纳斯把那孩子交给我们，要我们保护她的安全。他没有解释原因，不过也不需要。我早已明白她的身份，也知道她未来会成为怎样的人。— 潜行者萨满法夫涵

english.CardLore_4003: Fighting is like crushing someone's skull with a tree trunk. That's an analogy! — Keefe Treekiller, the Ogre Bruiser

english.CardLore_4007: Ever since I heard about the Jasper Circle I wanted to be a part of it, but a group like that... you don't ask to join, you have to be approached... which means you need to make a name for yourself. Six months I shadowed Sunbreeze. Six months of watching that stupid fairy do stupid merchant fairy things. Finally I had a plan. Then the Veiled Sisterhood went and assassinated Kwerthias which ruined everything. Sure I could have killed Sunbreeze, but then people would have given the Sisterhood the credit, so I just said to hell with it and scrapped everything. — Debbi, Foiled Assassin

schinese.CardLore_4007: 自从听过碧玉会的大名后，我做梦都想加入。不过这种团体……不是想进就能进的，只能等对方主动找上门来……也就是说我得先打响自己的名号。于是我花了六个月秘密跟踪晴风，整整六个月看着那个蠢妖精做些妖精商人的蠢事。最后我终于想出了一个主意，结果魅影之纱姐妹会的人却下手暗杀了奎堤亚斯，毁了我的计划。我当然可以杀了晴风，不过那样人们都会以为是姐妹会下的手，所以我只说了句去死吧，把我的计划抛诸脑后。— 挫败的刺客德比

english.CardLore_4008: The people I lead are small in number but vast in potential... and I will not see them slaughtered as the forest burns. The time has come for us to leave our ancestral home; and so I will lead my tribe to Weeping Rose... there our magicks will be celebrated, not feared. — The Dark Troll Chieftain on his people's exodus

schinese.CardLore_4008: 我的子民人数不多，但个个潜力无穷……我绝不会让他们随着森林陷入火海而被屠戮殆尽。现在，我们该离开世代生活的家园了。我会带领我的部族前往悲玫城……在那里，我们的魔法将受到热情欢迎，而非遭人惧怕。— 黑暗巨魔酋长讲述子民背井离乡

english.CardLore_10001: Most people are content eeking out an existence... eat. Work. Copulate. Sleep. This cycle continues, ad nauseam yielding useless children that are raised by their useless parents to have useless purposes in life. But I am not most people. I am a man of vision. My daughters are creations of purpose. And together we will spread a delicious poison across this countryside, purging it of weakness and stupidity. — Lesale, the Venomancer

schinese.CardText_10001: [abilityname[剧毒本性]]每次[g:204[部署阶段]]，[g:409[召唤]]一名[[瘟疫守卫]]至{s:thisCardName}的兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10001: 大多数人都满足于浑浑噩噩地度日……吃饭、干活、交配、睡觉。如此循环持续下去，生产出那些令人作呕又无用的后代，再被他们无用的父母养大，继续过着毫无意义的生活。但我不是这种人。我是个有远见的人。我的女儿们就是带着目的降生。我们将一起在这土地上撒下美味的毒药，清除它的软弱和愚蠢。— 剧毒术士里瑟尔

card_text.english: Summon two Plague Wards.
card_text.schinese: 召唤两名瘟疫守卫。

english.CardLore_10002: I like to take time when placing my creations, ensuring that each of my daughters has a chance to blossom into what they are destined to become...but sometimes I'm seized with inspiration and tend to my work faster than normal. — Venomancer, Wicked Gardener

schinese.CardLore_10002: 我喜欢花时间来布置我的创造，以确保我的每个女儿都有机会按计划茁壮成长……但有时我也会充满灵感，比平时更快地投入工作。— 邪恶园丁剧毒术士

english.CardLore_10004: I'm not going to lie, life's been a little rough. I was on a tear playin' the couriers in White Spire, when all of a sudden I hit a cold streak. It happens. We figure we were due for a win so we go to Momma Eeb and take out a marker. Based on past dealings, Eeb's not too keen to let us borrow the money so we give her Meepo 3 as a collateral. We go back to the track, and well- look, I can't stress enough how cold the couriers were that day. We have a team meeting and decide it's not fair that Meepo 3 gets his legs broken because a sure thing fell through. So I go the Jasper Circle and get a loan to pay Eeb and get Meepo 3 back. But now we're in it with the Jasper Circle so we really don't want to take any chances because Momma Eeb will mess you up, Lasan will straight up kill ya. So we decide to do some odd jobs for the Ravenhooks and skim enough money off the top to be able to pay back the Jasper Circle, but that's when I realize that there's no way we could get cleaned out 3 times in a row... you're smart people, I think you can figure out where this is going. So mistakes were made and now we're back to where we started with the Jasper Circle debt only this time the Ravenhooks won't take us back because, ya know, we robbed them. We're freaking out and pointing fingers, and that's when Meepo 3 sees a wanted poster for our old friend Mireska. Now Lord Sunbreeze has put a huge bounty on his daughter that would cover the Jasper debt in spades, but A: Mireska's a friend... and more importantly B: there was no way we'd get to her before Gondar did. So I come up with a new plan. Gondar will capture Mireska. We'll free Mireska. Mireska will owe us. And Mireska will keep the Jasper Circle from killing us. It's a perfect plan. What could go wrong? — Meepo, Petty Con Man

schinese.CardLore_10004: 我不打算说假话，最近日子不太顺。我曾经在白色尖塔赌信使赢得风生水起，但突然之间就走了背运。啧，倒霉事总是会发生嘛。我们觉得自己一定会赢，所以就去找了艾布妈妈跟她赊账。按照过去的经验，她当然不会白白把钱借给我们，所以我们把米波三号抵押给了她。然后我们重新上场，但——反正我就不细数那天到底爆了多少场冷门。我们大伙自个儿开了个会，最后决定不能因为本来十拿九稳的注给砸了，就眼睁睁地看米波三号给人打断腿。所以我去了趟碧玉会，贷了一笔钱还清了艾布的债，把米波三号赎了出来。不过，这么一来我们就被记在碧玉会的账册上了，所以这次肯定不能再搞砸；欠了艾布妈妈他会让你日子不好过，欠了拉山他会直接要你的命。我们决定帮勾财黑鸦们打点零工，顺便揩点油水，好还钱给碧玉会。那会儿我还觉得我们不可能连着三次都输得精光……你很聪明，肯定能猜到后来发生了什么。总之我们失了手，现在又被打回原形，只不过现在除了欠碧玉会一大笔钱之外，勾财黑鸦们也不会再帮我们了，因为，我们抢了他嘛，没办法。正当我们走投无路，互相吹胡子瞪眼睛的时候，米波三号发现了一张悬赏令，找的是我们的老相识米瑞斯嘉。晴风领主为了找女儿开了个大价钱。这笔钱足够还清我们欠碧玉会的债。但是首先，米瑞斯嘉是我们的朋友……更重要的是第二点：我们没办法赶在刚铎之前找到她……所以我想出了个新计划。刚铎会把米瑞斯嘉捉住,我们再去把她放出来。这样她欠我们一个人情，就会保护我们不被碧玉会杀掉。这计划多完美啊，怎么可能出错呢？— 不入流的骗子米波

card_text.english: Summon a Meepo.
card_text.schinese: 召唤一名米波。

english.CardLore_10005: I think it's important to have friends that can compensate for your weakness. For instance, I'm great at playing cards; whereas Meepo 2 is more of a dice guy. Does that mean we all get along? Of course not, one of us is always getting the rest of us in trouble... but at the end of the day, we always work together to find a way out... because if you can't count on yourselves... who can you count on? — Meepo, Team of Grifters

schinese.CardLore_10005: 我认为，找到一个能和你取长补短的朋友相当重要。比如，我特别擅长打牌，而米波二号则更精通骰子。这是说我们总能和睦相处吗？当然不是了。每个人都会给其他人惹出点麻烦……但到最后，我们总是一起找解决办法……因为，如果你自己都不能指望自己，那还能靠谁呢？— 骗徒团米波

english.CardLore_10006: Once I was like Sorla Khan... a warlord that did as she pleased. Strong and immortal I knew that no man or beast was my equal... until my hubris cost me everything. It was there at my lowest that Selemene found me. Tested me. And showed me the moon lit path. Much time has passed since that day, and I find purpose and pride in protecting the Nightsilver Woods with other members of the Dark Moon. But word has spread of Sorla Khan's march, and while we have never met I understand her all too well. And so I travel to Roseleaf to defeat her, and save her from herself. — Luna, the Moon Rider

schinese.CardLore_10006: 我曾经像索尔拉可汗一样，是个为所欲为的战士。我拥有强大且永恒的力量，人或野兽都无可匹敌……直到我因自傲而失去一切。在我人生的低谷，赛莉蒙妮找到了我，考验我，带领我踏上这条洒满月光的道路。自从那一天起已过了许久，现在我的人生目标与荣耀，就是与其他暗月成员一起保护银夜森林。然而，我听闻索尔拉可汗开始长征，虽然我们未曾谋面，但我知她如知己，因此我决定前往玫叶城击败她，避免她自取灭亡。— 暗月骑士露娜

english.CardLore_10010: Writers block. It is an awful condition that can ensure even the most prolific of authors. Once the words used to flow freely from my lips to my scribe Thrael's ears...but lately I have been... distracted by the pulp drivel Goodkind unleashes into the world. I had no idea that the adventures of a monosyllabic red thug could capture so many readers, yet if I am to be honest my own works feel boring in comparison... its vexing. Ah well, I guess it's time to find Goodkind and eat her. — Auroth, the Winter Wyvern

schinese.CardText_10010: [abilityname[严寒烧灼]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]]将{s:thisCardName}移至一个空白战斗位置，并使其在本回合+4[g:509[攻击]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10010: 写作瓶颈。这种可怕的情形，即便是最知名多产的作家也躲不过。曾几何时，文字从我唇齿间自如地流淌到抄写员瑟瑞尔的耳中……但是最近……我被小古流入世中的低俗趣味和胡言乱语分散了注意力。我不知道为什么一个寡言少语红色暴徒的历险能吸引这么多读者，但老实说，相比之下，我自己的作品却又显得着实无聊……这真令人恼火。啊好吧，我想我该去找到小古，把她给吃了。— 寒冬飞龙傲洛斯

card_text.english: Disarm a unit until end of round.  That unit's allied neighbors battle it.
card_text.schinese: 缴械一个单位直至回合结束为止。使该单位的友方近邻与其战斗。

english.CardText_10011: [g:404[Disarm]] a [g:607[unit]] until end of round. [g:608[□]] That [g:607[unit]]'s [g:601[allied neighbors]] [g:400[battle]] it.
english.CardLore_10011: Feeble minds can prove useful for fleeting entertainment. — Winter Wyvern, Bored Poet

schinese.CardLore_10011: 软弱的意志可以提供暂时的消遣。— 无聊的诗人寒冬飞龙

card_text.english:
Feral Impulse
Lycan's allied neighbors have +2 Attack.
card_text.schinese:
野性驱使
狼人的友方近邻+2攻击。

english.CardLore_10014: My father was good man. A regent over the lands of Slom, he ruled the small folk with fairness and justice. My mother was the picture of patience and compassion, a woman beloved by her people as if they were her children. And my siblings? Gods we were trouble. I remember the day we found Father's collection of ancient maps, Tressa thought it would be funny if we- it doesn't matter now. They're all dead. — Banehallow, the Lycan

schinese.CardLore_10014: 我父亲是个好人。他是斯洛姆的摄政王，公平公正地统治着这个小国的百姓。我的母亲则是坚韧与慈爱的化身，臣民们都把她当作自己的母亲一样来爱戴。至于我的兄弟姐妹，嘿，我们可没少惹麻烦。我至今还记得那一天，我们找到了父亲收藏的古代地图，特蕾莎有了个有趣的鬼主意，要是我们——不过现在这些都不重要了。他们都死了。— 狼人贝恩霍勒

card_text.english:
Borrowed Time
Active 2: Fully heal Abaddon and give it Damage Immunity this round.
card_text.schinese:
回光返照
主动2：完整治疗亚巴顿，并使其在本回合获得伤害免疫。

english.CardText_10016: [abilityname[Borrowed Time]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Fully heal {s:thisCardName} and give it [g:507[Damage Immunity]] this round.]]
english.CardLore_10016: As a child I was baptized in the Font of Avernus...its black mist embracing me...enveloping me... becoming one with me. As a man I have wielded its power to defend the House of Avernus, and build a legacy that will never be forgotten. But rumors have reached my ears.... rumors that indicate that my familial font is not the only source of the mist... if this is true I must find it and consume it. For its blessings must remain mine alone. — Abaddon, the Lord of Avernus

schinese.CardText_10016: [abilityname[回光返照]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]]完整治疗{s:thisCardName}，并使其在本回合获得[g:507[伤害免疫]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10016: 小时候，我在魔霭圣池接受了洗礼……那黑色的迷雾拥抱着我……包裹着我……与我合而为一。成年后，借助它的力量，我保卫了魔霭家族，铸就了让人永远铭记的传奇。但最近我听到了传言……传言说我家族的圣池并非迷雾的唯一来源……如果真是这样，我必须找到它，将它摧毁。迷雾的祝福只能属于我一个人。— 魔霭之主亚巴顿

card_text.english:
Holy Persuasion
Active 4: Get control of an enemy creep.
card_text.schinese:
神圣劝化
主动4：控制一名敌方小兵。

english.CardLore_10017: The Rumusque Faithful have grown in number and in reputation and Lady Anshu is revered as a prophet and the second coming of Crella herself. Such a woman will be a powerful convert to the Knights of the Fold. And once I have shown her the true light of god... she will bring her followers to me. — Chen, Holy Knight of the Fold

schinese.CardText_10017: [abilityname[神圣劝化]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■4：]]控制一名敌方[g:1[小兵]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10017: 鲁姆斯克的信徒越来越多，名声也越来越响。安苏夫人被当作先知般崇拜，甚至被当作是克莱拉的转世。这位女士将会成为教会骑士的强大助力。一旦我向她展示了神灵的真正光芒……她就会带领着她的追随者来皈依我们。— 教会圣骑士陈

card_text.english:
Blood Bath
Fully heal Bloodseeker after a unit blocking it dies.
card_text.schinese:
屠戮
当阻挡其前的单位死亡后，完整治疗血魔。

english.CardText_10018: [abilityname[Blood Bath]]Fully heal {s:thisCardName} after a [g:607[unit]] blocking it dies.
english.CardLore_10018: My homeland is a place of beauty and grace... of crystal streams and bountiful harvest...it is undeniably a gift from the gods. But when such a gift is bestowed upon you, it is right to give thanks... and there is only one way to show gratitude to the Flayed Twins. With blood. — Strygwyr, the Bloodseeker

schinese.CardText_10018: [abilityname[屠戮]]当阻挡其前的[g:607[单位]]死亡后，完整治疗{s:thisCardName}。
schinese.CardLore_10018: 我的家乡美丽典雅……溪水清澈，土地丰饶……毫无疑问，是来自诸神的恩赐。获得这样的恩赐，理当感恩……而向剥皮双子表示感谢的方式只有一种，那就是鲜血。— 血魔史德利古尔

english.CardLore_10020: Axe is a man of many talents. Well one talent. The murder talent. However that seems to be enough for Axe to attract a legion of devoted fans that follow his adventures. It also probably helps that Axe's bard, Goodkind is good at what she calls 'embellishment'. Axe is unsure what the word means, but it's probably a good thing. — Axe, Adventurer and Murder Machine

schinese.CardLore_10020: 斧王天赋异禀、多才多艺。好吧，其实也就只有那么一项天赋而已：杀戮天赋。但这已足够吸引一批狂热的粉丝军团，关注他的冒险游记。这或许也得归功于斧王身边的吟游诗人，小古；她非常擅于“润色”。斧王不太懂这个词是什么意思，不过大概是件好事吧。— 冒险家和杀戮机器斧王

card_text.english:
Return
Centaur Warrunner has +2 Retaliate.
card_text.schinese:
反击
半人马战行者+2反伤。

english.CardLore_10021: The hunt is a sacred thing, and to be asked to lead it is a great honor. These centaurs claim to be the finest hunters of the Marrowfell Tribe. We shall see if any of them are worthy to claim the Horn of the Alpha. — Bradwarden, the Centaur Warrunner

schinese.CardLore_10021: 狩猎是件神圣的事，而被族人推选为狩猎的领袖则是无上荣光。这些半人马号称是断骨氏族中最优秀的猎手。我们就等着瞧他们当中谁有资格拿到领袖号角吧。— 半人马战行者布兰德瓦登

card_text.english:
Reactive Armor
Timbersaw has +1 Armor for each of its attackers. Timbersaw's attackers have -1 Armor.
card_text.schinese:
活性护甲
每有一个攻击者，伐木机便+1护甲。伐木机的攻击者-1护甲。

english.CardText_10022: [abilityname[Reactive Armor]]{s:thisCardName} has +1 [g:504[Armor]] for each of its attackers. {s:thisCardName}'s attackers have -1 [g:504[Armor]].
english.CardLore_10022: I know they think I'm crazy... and that's ok... they didn't see what I saw... see what the trees did. 'Ohh it's nature, look at the beauty of the forest.' Lies. That's not a tranquil jungle... that's a sleeping army. And unless we are prepared when that forest starts to march it will be the end of everybody. — Rizzrack, the Timbersaw

schinese.CardText_10022: [abilityname[活性护甲]]每有一个攻击者，{s:thisCardName}便+1[g:504[护甲]]。{s:thisCardName}的攻击者-1[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardLore_10022: 我知道他们都觉得我疯了……没什么大不了的……他们没见识过我看到的景象……没见识过那些树的骇人之处。“噢，大自然多美好，看看这座美丽的森林。”一派胡言。那可不是什么宁静的丛林……那是支尚未苏醒的军队。除非我们做好战斗准备，否则等到森林攻打过来，我们所有人都会完蛋。— 伐木机瑞兹拉克

card_text.english:
Jinada
Before the action phase, there is a 50% chance to give Bounty Hunter +4 Attack this round.
card_text.schinese:
忍术
行动阶段前，赏金猎人在本回合有50%几率+4攻击。

english.CardText_10023: [abilityname[Jinada]][g:200[Before the action phase]], there is a 50% chance to give {s:thisCardName} +4 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
english.CardLore_10023: Lord Sunbreeze is willing to pay handsomely to anyone who was able to return his daughter to him alive... which is somewhat unfortunate because 'Dead' is significantly easier for me. Oh well, the customer is always right. Looks like it's time to hunt a fairy. — Gondar, the Bounty Hunter

schinese.CardText_10023: [abilityname[忍术]][g:200[行动阶段前]]，{s:thisCardName}在本回合有50%几率+4[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10023: 只要有人能把他女儿活着弄回来，无论是谁晴风领主都愿意出个大价钱……这对我来说有点麻烦，因为弄个死人回来可容易多了。不过好吧，顾客就是上帝。看来我得去抓个仙女了。— 赏金猎人刚铎

card_text.english:
Ravage
Active 4: Stun Tidehunter's enemy neighbors this round and each other enemy has a 50% chance of being stunned this round.
card_text.schinese:
毁灭
主动4：在本回合晕眩潮汐猎人的敌方近邻，其他敌人也有50%几率被晕眩。

english.CardText_10024: [abilityname[Ravage]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■4:]] [g:405[Stun]] {s:thisCardName}'s [g:600[enemy neighbors]] this round and each other enemy has a 50% chance of being stunned this round.]]
english.CardLore_10024: My dominion over the seas is absolute... and soon it will be the same on land. — Leviathan, the Tidehunter

schinese.CardText_10024: [abilityname[毁灭]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■4：]]在本回合[g:405[晕眩]]{s:thisCardName}的[g:600[敌方近邻]]，其他敌人也有50%几率被晕眩。]]
schinese.CardLore_10024: 我是海中绝对的霸主……即将称霸陆地。— 潮汐猎人利维坦

card_text.english:
Laser
Active 3: Deal 3 damage to a unit and disarm it this round.
card_text.schinese:
激光
主动3：对一个单位造成3伤害，并在本回合使其缴械。

english.CardText_10025: [abilityname[Laser]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■3:]] Deal 3 damage to a [g:607[unit]] and [g:404[disarm]] it this round.]]
english.CardLore_10025: The idea of working with Mazzie is...less exciting to me. But Sniper has raised some excellent points: The keen have been divided for too long and at least he doesn't yell at trees. Still, it's hard for me to overlook our past. Do I think we'll be friends? No. Do I think I can stomach his presence and not 'accidently' shoot in him the back of the head? Maybe if I drink enough. Time will tell. — Boush, the Tinker

schinese.CardText_10025: [abilityname[激光]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■3：]]对一个[g:607[单位]]造成3伤害，并在本回合使其[g:404[缴械]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10025: 和梅兹共事，对我来说……没那么令人兴奋。但狙击手也提出了一些极好的观点：基恩人已经分裂得太久了。况且，至少他不会对着树大喊大叫。尽管如此，我还是很难忘掉我们的过去。你问我们会不会成为朋友？不可能。你问我能不能忍受他的存在而不“意外地”射中他的后脑勺？或许吧，如果我喝得够多的话。时间会证明一切。— 修补匠鲍什

card_text.english:
Relentless Rebel
Rix has Rapid Deployment.
card_text.schinese:
不懈叛军
瑞克斯具有快速部署。

english.CardLore_10026: I was conscripted to the Bronze Legion when I was a pup. They marched through my village with their shiny armor and promises of glory and I couldn't sign on fast enough. I smiled when they put the conscript mark on my arm cause I knew that if I worked hard enough, if I followed orders, if I showed valor and skill in battle I would make something of myself and become more than just a stupid savage from redmaw. And so I followed. And fought. And killed. And with every town we occupied, every insurrection we quelled, every voice of dissent I silenced, the words 'for the glory of Stonehall' grew hollower, and that bronzed mark I took pride in became heavier. So now we march through Roseleaf to intercept the Red Mist Horde, and again my Commander has asked me to 'speak to my savage people'... well speak to them I shall... and when I do, they'll understand that I will fight beside them until every soldier is sent back to Stonehall in a bronzed coffin. — Rix, Leader of the Vhoul Rebellion

schinese.CardLore_10026: 我还是个幼崽时就被征召进了古铜军团。他们在行军时经过我的村庄，看着他们闪亮的盔甲，听着他们许诺的荣耀，我迫不及待地加入了他们。当他们在我的手臂上印下征召的印记时，我露出了开心的微笑。因为我知道只要付出努力，服从命令，在战斗中展示出勇气与技巧，我就可以摆脱来自赤喉的野蛮人身份，有所成就。我跟随军团不断地战斗，不断地杀戮。我们征服了一座座村庄、镇压了一场场叛乱，我亲手让一个个反对的声音归于沉寂，但“为了石堂城的荣耀”这句口号变得越来越空洞，我引以为傲的古铜印记也越来越沉重。现在我们前往玫叶城，阻击红雾部落，我的指挥官又一次要求我“去和我的野蛮族人谈谈”。好吧，我会去和他们谈……到时候，他们就会知道我会与他们并肩作战，直到军团的每个士兵都被装进青铜棺材，送回石堂城。— 豺狼人反抗领袖瑞克斯

card_text.english:
Corrosive Skin
When a unit deals battle damage to Viper, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
card_text.schinese:
腐蚀皮肤
当一个单位对冥界亚龙造成战斗伤害时，修改该单位，使其-1攻击。

english.CardText_10028: [abilityname[Corrosive Skin]]When a [g:607[unit]] deals [g:609[battle damage]] to {s:thisCardName}, [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].
english.CardLore_10028: Once Pugna used me. Controlled me. Owned me. Eventually I escaped, and while at first I relished in my newfound freedom, as years passed it became a more hollow existence... for a while I thought this ennui came because my tormentor still roamed free, and I wouldn't find peace until I make him suffer as I did. But after I began my quest for vengeance I came to a realization. Pugna is not an abnormality. How many dabble in magic to summon and control. To create life then force it to obey. No. Pugna's enslavement won't bring me peace... but enslaving every wizard? Now that is something that will help me sleep well at night. — Viper, the Netherdrake

schinese.CardText_10028: [abilityname[腐蚀皮肤]]当一个[g:607[单位]]对{s:thisCardName}造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]时，[g:401[修改]]该[g:607[单位]]，使其-1[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10028: 我曾被帕格纳利用、控制和奴役。最终我逃了出来。起初，我将来之不易的自由视若珍宝，但多年之后，我感到了一种前所未有的空虚……我曾以为会有这种感觉是因为折磨我的人仍过得逍遥自在，只有让他也尝到那种滋味，我才能获得平静。然而，踏上复仇之旅后，我明白了一件事。帕格纳并不是个异数，有多少怪物像他一样，玩弄魔法用于召唤和操纵生命？创造生命，随后将其奴役？不。单单让帕格纳失去自由，还不足以让我回归平静……但如果把所有玩弄法术者都囚禁起来？如果真得能做到，我想我就能睡上好觉了。 — 冥界亚龙蝮蛇

card_text.english:
Call of the Wild
Active 3: Summon a Loyal Beast.
card_text.schinese:
野性呼唤
主动3：召唤一头忠诚野兽。

english.CardLore_10029: Every year the Marrowfell Centaurs send their bravest warriors into Roseleaf to hunt Thunderhides... to them this gruesome safari is a rite of passage, but I will not let these majestic creatures be hunted for sport. The only question that remains is how many centaurs will I have to kill before they realize Roseleaf Forest is no longer their hunting grounds. — Karroch, the Beastmaster

schinese.CardText_10029: [abilityname[野性呼唤]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■3：]][g:409[召唤]]一头[[忠诚野兽]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10029: 每一年，断骨半人马都会把他们最勇敢的勇士送到玫叶去猎杀雷肤兽……这种残忍的狩猎对他们来说是成年礼，但我不会让那些高贵的生物成为他们狩猎的对象。唯一的问题是，我需要杀死多少半人马，才能让他们明白，玫叶森林并不是他们的狩猎场。— 兽王卡洛克

card_text.english:
Barroom Brawler
Modify Bristleback with +2 Armor after a hero blocking it dies.
card_text.schinese:
酒馆醉拳
当阻挡其前的英雄死亡后，修改钢背兽，使其+2护甲。

english.CardText_10030: [abilityname[Barroom Brawler]][g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +2 [g:504[Armor]] after a [g:0[hero]] blocking it dies.
english.CardLore_10030: I never went to some fancy military school to learn how to beat a man half to death... that's what bars were for. — Bristleback, Barfly

schinese.CardText_10030: [abilityname[酒馆醉拳]]当阻挡其前的[g:0[英雄]]死亡后，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+2[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardLore_10030: 我没上啥高级军校去学怎么把人揍得半死……这去酒吧就能学到了。— 酒鬼钢背兽

card_text.english:
Bringer of Conquest
The random allied Melee Creeps are deployed into Kanna's lane.
card_text.schinese:
征服使者
将随机友方近战小兵部署至卡娜的兵线。

english.CardText_10031: [abilityname[Bringer of Conquest]]The random allied [[Melee Creeps]] are deployed into {s:thisCardName}'s lane.
english.CardLore_10031: I am a woman of my word. I promised my mother that I would find a way to fix my frail body, and I found salvation in the Dire. In exchange I promised the Dire a mighty army... and here you stand. And on the day we built this citadel I promised I would give you purpose... and you have found it in the glory of battle and the honor of serving The Dire. I am a woman of my word, and today I make a new promise: soon Prellex's body will be crushed in the rubble of her false god, and on that day you will be rewarded beyond all measure. — Kanna, Priestess of the Dire

schinese.CardText_10031: [abilityname[征服使者]]将随机友方[[近战小兵]]部署至{s:thisCardName}的兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10031: 我言出必行。我向母亲许诺过会设法修复我孱弱的身躯，而夜魇赐予我救赎。作为交换，我向夜魇起誓要建立一支强大的军队……而你们就是这支军队。在我们修成这座城池的那天，我答应会赋予你们存在的意义……你们已在为夜魇而战的荣耀与光辉中寻找到了目的与意义。我言出必行，且今天我要许下新的诺言：我很快就会将普瑞蕾斯和她的伪神一起碾得粉碎。到那一天，你们将会得到无价的奖赏。— 夜魇女祭司卡娜

card_text.english:
Precision Aura
Other allies in all lanes have +1 Attack.
card_text.schinese:
精准灵气
所有兵线上的其他友方单位+1攻击。

english.CardText_10032: [abilityname[Precision Aura]]Other allies in all lanes have +1 [g:509[Attack]].
english.CardLore_10032: Power is a funny thing. It's something we all want but are taught to be ashamed to seek. But power is neither good nor evil. It's freedom. It's the ability to live the life you choose, on the terms that you want. People like to criticize where that power came from but in time, history forgets... and only remembers what you chose to do with it. People can judge me for helping Kanna. But in time they will understand. — Traxex, the Drow Ranger

schinese.CardText_10032: [abilityname[精准灵气]]所有兵线上的其他友方单位+1[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10032: 力量是个有趣的东西，所有人都渴望力量，却认为追寻力量是可耻的。然而，力量不分善恶，而是自由，让你有能力选择生活方式，爱怎么过就怎么过。人们总爱对力量的来源指指点点，但时间久了，历史会忘记，只记得你如何使用这份力量。人们可以批评我帮助卡娜，但他们早晚会明白的。 — 卓尔游侠崔希丝

card_text.english:
Fissure
Active 4: Stun Earthshaker's enemy neighbors this round.
card_text.schinese:
沟壑
主动4：在本回合晕眩撼地者的敌方近邻。

english.CardLore_10033: My existence shouldn't be. I was not born of a mother, but from a rock...and yet I was carved by no artisan. No... I willed my consciousness into being. For so long, I walked alone... confused... but that all changed when I met Kanna. I was rudderless, and she gave me direction. I was ignorant of the ways of man, and she gave me understanding. I was alone in this world, and she gave me companionship. But above all, she gave me a name and sense of self. Once I called myself Raigor Stonehoof...but she has given me a new name that is far more fitting...Earthshaker. — Earthshaker, Adopted Son

schinese.CardText_10033: [abilityname[沟壑]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■4：]]在本回合[g:405[晕眩]]{s:thisCardName}的[g:600[敌方近邻]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10033: 我本不该存于世上。我无父无母，生自岩石，也不是由匠人雕琢而成。不是的……我自然通了灵气。很长一段时间里，我孤身一人……困惑迷茫……但是，我遇到卡娜之后，一切都不一样了。我找不到方向，是她给了我指引。我不了解处事之道，是她教会了我。我在这世上孑然一身，是她给了我陪伴。但最重要的是，她给了我一个名字以及存在的意义。我曾经自称瑞格·石蹄……但她给了我一个更适合我的新名字……撼地者。 — 被收养的撼地者

card_text.english:
Nature's Attendants
Enchantress has +2 Regeneration. Enchantress's allied neighbors have +2 Regeneration.
card_text.schinese:
自然之助
魅惑魔女+2恢复。魅惑魔女的友方近邻+2恢复。

english.CardLore_10036: Rix. Tresdin. Sorla Khan. You ask any one of them and they will spin you a story about why their cause is just; and every single one of them is wrong. This war is senseless, its cost will be immeasurable, and the only people who will profit are the future historians who'll sell books about the massacre. I can't stop this war from happening... but I will do whatever I can to minimize the damage. — Aiustha, the Enchantress

schinese.CardText_10036: [abilityname[自然之助]]{s:thisCardName}+2[g:505[恢复]]。{s:thisCardName}的[g:601[友方近邻]]+2[g:505[恢复]]。
schinese.CardLore_10036: 瑞克斯、特蕾丝汀、索尔拉可汗。不管你去问谁，他们都会编一个故事给你，证明他们的事业是正义的。但他们都错了。这场战争本身毫无意义，而花费的代价又无法估量，唯一能从中受益的是未来的史学家，他们可以靠记述这些屠杀的书赚不少钱。我没法阻止这场战争的发生……但我会尽量减少战争带来的伤害。— 魅惑魔女爱由莎

card_text.english:
Sacrifice
Active 2: Condemn another ally and draw a card. If that ally has 6 or more Attack, draw an extra card.
card_text.schinese:
献祭
主动2：惩处另一个友方单位并抽一张牌。如果该友方单位的攻击为6或以上，则多抽一张牌。

english.CardText_10038: [abilityname[Sacrifice]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] [g:408[Condemn]] another ally and draw a card. If that ally has 6 or more [g:509[Attack]], draw an extra card.]]
english.CardLore_10038: Opportunity calls to me in Roseleaf. Lion flees to Weeping Rose, and will undoubtedly be looking for allies to aid him. The Vhoul are losing their battle against The Bronze Legion and are willing to do anything for victory... and the Crystal Maiden of Icewrack happens to be on holiday. It truly is an embarrassment of riches. The only lingering question is who should I kill first. — Ethreain, the Lich

schinese.CardText_10038: [abilityname[献祭]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]][g:408[惩处]]另一个友方单位并抽一张牌。如果该友方单位的[g:509[攻击]]为6或以上，则多抽一张牌。]]
schinese.CardLore_10038: 机运将我带到了玫叶城。莱恩逃到了悲玫城，他肯定会要找盟友帮忙。豺狼人输给了古铜军团，为了获胜他们会不择手段……冰川残骸的冰晶圣女则是刚好放假。选择太多还真是种奢侈的烦恼，唯一该问的就是我该从谁杀起。— 巫妖艾斯瑞安

card_text.english:
Multicast
After you play a blue spell, there is a 25% chance to put a base copy of that card into your hand.
card_text.schinese:
多重施法
打出一张蓝色法术后，有25%几率将该卡牌的基础副本加入你的手牌。

english.CardText_10043: [abilityname[Multicast]]After you play a [color:blue[blue [g:4[spell]]]], there is a 25% chance to put a base copy of that card into your hand.
english.CardLore_10043:
'It's not easy being the smartest ogre in the world. There's lots of jealous people out there.'
'Think about how many people you know with one head.'
'I bet it's a lot.'
'Now realize that every single one of them is half as smart as us. Do you know how lonely it is to walk this earth, never finding an intellectual eq-'
'WE LIKE ROCKS!'
'Yes...yes we do.' — Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi

schinese.CardText_10043: [abilityname[多重施法]]打出一张[color:blue[蓝色[g:4[法术]]]]后，有25%几率将该卡牌的基础副本加入你的手牌。
schinese.CardLore_10043:
“身为世界上最聪明的食人魔不是件容易的事，大家都忌妒我们。”
“想想看你认识多少个只有一颗头的人？ ”
“我猜一定很多吧。”
“然后他们所有人都只有我们一半聪明，你知道这有多孤独吗？活在这世上永远找不到一个跟我们一样聪明的…… ”
“我们爱石头！ ”
“是是是…… 很爱很爱。”— 食人魔魔法师阿格隆·碎石者

card_text.english:
Purification
Active 2: Heal a unit 3.
card_text.schinese:
洗礼
主动2：对一个单位进行3治疗。

english.CardLore_10044: Something is stirring in Roseleaf. I'm not referring to Stonehall's war machine, or the Red Mist Horde... no... those are problems of flesh and blood, distractions keeping attention divided from the real danger. The Court of Ristul. But I cannot face this danger alone, and so I hope to meet with Luna of the Dark Moon. With the combined might of Selemene and the All Seeing One, we may have a chance. — Omniknight, Devoted to the Allseeing One

schinese.CardText_10044: [abilityname[洗礼]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]]对一个[g:607[单位]]进行3治疗。]]
schinese.CardLore_10044: 玫叶城中有股势力在蠢蠢欲动，我指的不是石堂城的好战份子，也不是红雾那帮人，不……那些凡夫俗子担心的问题让人忽视了真正的危险——瑞斯托王廷。然而，我只身难敌如此险恶，因此我希望与暗月的露娜会面。结合赛莉蒙妮和全视者的力量，我们或许还有一线生机。— 献身全视者的全知骑士

card_text.english:
Essence Aura
After you play a blue card, there is a 50% chance to restore 2 Mana.
card_text.schinese:
精华灵气
打出一张蓝色卡牌后，有50%几率恢复2魔力。

english.CardText_10046: [abilityname[Essence Aura]]After you play a [color:blue[blue card]], there is a 50% chance to restore 2 [g:511[Mana]].
english.CardLore_10046: The Dire Child has begun to come into her own. She will need guidance. Molding. She has chosen the beast to be her champion... but I shall be her seneschal...and eventually... her master. — Harbinger, the Outworld Devourer

schinese.CardText_10046: [abilityname[精华灵气]]打出一张[color:blue[蓝色卡牌]]后，有50%几率恢复2[g:511[魔力]]。
schinese.CardLore_10046: 夜魇之女的羽翼渐丰。她需要指引和磨练。她选中那头野兽做她的护卫……我呢，会掌管她的大小事务，最终……成为她的主人。 — 先兆者殁境神蚀者

card_text.english:
Efficient Killer
Phantom Assassin deals +4 damage when attacking a hero.
card_text.schinese:
杀戮高手
幻影刺客攻击英雄时，造成+4伤害。

english.CardText_10047: [abilityname[Efficient Killer]]{s:thisCardName} deals +4 damage when attacking a [g:0[hero]].
english.CardLore_10047: The Veiled Sisterhood gave me everything. My life. My skills. My family... My very purpose. So when the Veiled Oracles provide me a list of names, I never question what it is I need to do. — Mortred, the Phantom Assassin

schinese.CardText_10047: [abilityname[杀戮高手]]{s:thisCardName}攻击[g:0[英雄]]时，造成+4伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10047: 魅影之纱姐妹会给了我一切：我的生命、我的技能、我的家人……我生存的意义。因此当魅纱神谕者交付名单给我时，我一句都不会多问。— 幻影刺客茉崔蒂

card_text.english:
Nether Blast
Active 3: Condemn a random enemy improvement.
card_text.schinese:
幽冥爆轰
主动3：惩处一个随机敌方强化。

english.CardLore_10048: The Tyler Estate. It seeks to control magic. Punish those that violate rules set by the Quorum. But I will show them that some things cannot be controlled. And when the Tyler Estate Burns, I will set my sights on Weeping Rose itself. — Pugna, Ill-Tempered Nihilist

schinese.CardText_10048: [abilityname[幽冥爆轰]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■3：]][g:408[惩处]]一个随机敌方[g:3[强化]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10048: 泰勒庄园。他们总想控制魔法，还有惩罚所有违反评议团制定的规则的人。但我要让他们知道，有些东西是无法控制的。等到泰勒庄园化为火海的那天，我会把目光转向悲玫城。— 暴躁的虚无主义者帕格纳

card_text.english:
Headshot
Active 3: Deal 5 damage to a unit.
card_text.schinese:
爆头
主动3：对一个单位造成5伤害。

english.CardLore_10050: For too long the Keenfolk have been fractured. Little colonies spread across the world each coveting their own research... but as we kept to our workshops the world around us changed. Stonehall rose to power. The nation of Revtel was born. The Quroum of Weeping Rose grew bolder... and what did we do? We toiled and tinkered. We built wondrous machines and used them for petty tasks. This cannot continue. The Keenfolk clans need to unite, and show the world what we're capable of. — Kardel, the Sniper

schinese.CardText_10050: [abilityname[爆头]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■3：]]对一个[g:607[单位]]造成5伤害。]]
schinese.CardLore_10050: 基恩一族离散各地已太久了。各自在世界的角落成立小小的聚落，埋首钻研于自己的研究……在我们把自己关在工坊里头时，世界已换了样貌；石堂城掌权，瑞文泰尔立国，悲玫城的评议团壮大……而我们做了些什么呢？我们挥汗如雨、修修补补，造出令人赞叹的机器，却拿来做些鸡毛蒜皮的小事。不能再这样下去了。基恩一族必须团结一气，向世人展现我们的能耐。狙击手卡德尔

english.CardLore_10052: So there I was: drinking with my friends, well actually I was drinking alone but I was thinking about my friends so it's basically the same thing. Anyway. Sniper walks into my workshop and is like 'Mazzie, you're wasting your life' and I'm like 'Geeze Sniper, if I wanted to feel bad about myself I'd ask my parents why they never visit me on my birthday' but Sniper's not interested in hearing about parental abandonment, he's interested in uniting the Keenfolk clans. So I say I'll help: on the condition that I get to give our group a cool name. Sniper rolled his eyes and sighed, which is basically the same thing as a yes, and THAT'S how the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk was born. — Mazzie, Founding Member of the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk

schinese.CardLore_10052: 事情是这个样子的：我当时在跟一群朋友喝酒，好吧，其实只有我一个人在喝酒，但是我在想我那群朋友，所以基本上是一回事。总之，狙击手来到了我的工坊，抛来了一句：“梅兹，你这是在浪费生命”；然后我说：“啊哟，狙击手，要是我想让自己感到郁闷不如人，那我会去问我爸妈，为什么他们从不帮我庆生。”但是狙击手没兴趣听什么家庭决裂的事，他一心只想团结起基恩族人。所以，我便说我会出手，但条件是我们这群人的拉风名字得由我来取。狙击手翻了个白眼，叹了气，基本上就是同意的意思。这就是基恩人共识会的由来。— 基恩人共识会创始成员梅兹

card_text.english:
Bringer of the Faithful
Summon a Melee Creep into Prellex's lane each deployment phase.
card_text.schinese:
信仰使者
g:204部署阶段，召唤一名近战小兵至普瑞蕾斯的兵线。

english.CardText_10053: [abilityname[Bringer of the Faithful]][g:409[Summon]] a [[Melee Creep]] into {s:thisCardName}'s lane each [g:204[deployment phase]].
english.CardLore_10053: Brothers and sisters, The Ancient is coming. With every passing day my visions grow stronger: A violet sky. A sundered moon. And an Ancient voice that whispers 'Prepare for my arrival.' Prepare. Such a simple word that does no justice to the work that lies before us... We must be heralds; walking testimonies to the benevolence of The Ancient. Spreading the word of its glorious arrival, no matter if that message is received with joy or scorn. We must be architects; building not just this monastery for those who believe what I have seen, but an entire world that is worthy of the Ancient's splendor. We must be zealots; willing to lay down our lives in defense of this sacred space, because rest assured we are at war. Kanna and her heretics will stop at nothing to undo the work that we've accomplished, and that is why we must return in kind. — Prellex, Priestess of the Radiant

schinese.CardText_10053: [abilityname[信仰使者]][每次[g:204[部署阶段]]，[g:409[召唤]]一名[[近战小兵]]至{s:thisCardName}的兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10053: 兄弟姐妹们，遗迹就要降临了。我所受的启示随着每一天愈见清晰：深沉的夜色中，一轮残月悬空，还有遗迹的声音在低语：“准备迎接我的降临。” 准备。说起来容易，完全体现不了我们面前的繁重工作……我们要成为先行者，印证遗迹的仁爱，四处宣告这无上荣耀的驾临——无论收到讯息的人们是欢呼雀跃还是轻蔑不屑。我们要成为建筑师，不仅为笃信我所见的诸位建造这座修道院，还要让这整个世界配得上遗迹的荣光。我们要成为忠实的追随者，甘愿为守护这片圣地奉献生命，因为毫无疑问，我们的战争已经开始。卡娜和她手下的异教徒们将会不遗余力地破坏我们辛苦建立的一切，而我们，必须以眼还眼。— 天辉女祭司普瑞蕾斯

card_text.english:
Great Cleave
Sven has +X Cleave where X is equal to half its Attack.
card_text.schinese:
巨力挥舞
斯温+X顺势，X为其攻击的一半。

english.CardText_10054: [abilityname[Great Cleave]]{s:thisCardName} has +X [g:502[Cleave]] where X is equal to half its [g:509[Attack]].
english.CardLore_10054: I've given myself to the Vigil Knights. I will train with them. Learn their ways. Become the best... and ultimately: destroy them from within. — Sven, Knight of the Vigil

schinese.CardText_10054: [abilityname[巨力挥舞]]{s:thisCardName}+X[g:502[顺势]]，X为其[g:509[攻击]]的一半。
schinese.CardLore_10054: 我献身守夜骑士团，与他们一起训练、学习他们的骑士精神，成为当中最杰出的一员……最终，我将从内部摧毁他们。— 守夜骑士斯温

card_text.english:
Branches of Iron
Treant Protector's allied neighbors have +2 Armor.
card_text.schinese:
钢铁树枝
树精卫士的友方近邻+2护甲。

english.CardLore_10056: My feelings on the war in roseleaf are... complicated. Neither the bronze legion nor the red mist are threats to my people, and yet my cousins willingly intercede on the Vhoul's behalf. Their fondness for such frail creatures is strange to me, but none the less they call for my aid, and I am compelled to answer. — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

schinese.CardLore_10056: 我对玫叶战争的感受很……复杂。无论是古铜军团还是红雾都并未威胁我的族人，但我的表亲们却愿意为豺狼人斡旋。他们对这些脆弱生物的喜爱让我觉得奇怪，但他们请求我的帮助，我不得不做出回应。— 树精卫士鲁夫特伦

card_text.english:
Warmonger
Sorla Khan deals +4 damage when attacking a tower.
card_text.schinese:
好战者
索尔拉可汗攻击塔时，造成+4伤害。

english.CardLore_10058: I'm not oblivious to my reputation. I won't even pretend that it's un-earned. I've lead the Red Mist from town to town taking whatever it is we want... and what we want is to survive. So yes. I am a warlord. I have done and will do unspeakable things. But make no mistake, I am no conqueror. I am the Savior of the Oglodi. It's just an unfortunate reality that my people's salvation means your people's destruction. — Sorla, Khan of the Red Mist

schinese.CardLore_10058: 我不在乎别人怎么看我。我也承认这是我应得的。我带领红雾走遍各个城镇，挨家挨户洗劫一空……我们想要的就是活命。没错，我是个战争头子。我做过，而且还会做许多为人所不齿的事。但千万别搞错了，我并不是征服者。我可是高地人的救星。不幸的是现实就是这么残酷，不是你死就是我亡。— 红雾可汗索尔拉

card_text.english:
Sadist
Modify Necrophos with +1 Health after an enemy neighbor dies.
card_text.schinese:
施虐之心
g:600敌方近邻死亡后，修改瘟疫法师，使其+1生命。

english.CardLore_10059: For years I travelled, spreading the gift of pestilence city by city. But now a unique opportunity has arisen. If I can infect the Red Mist Horde... they can do the travelling for me, and pass along my gift faster than I could ever dream. — Rotund'jere, the Necrophos

schinese.CardText_10059: [abilityname[施虐之心]][一个[g:600[敌方近邻]]死亡后，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+1[g:510[生命]]。
schinese.CardLore_10059: 多年以来，我四处游荡，向一座又一座城市馈赠疫病。现在，一个独一无二的机会摆在我面前。如果我能感染红雾部落……那他们可以为我跑腿，以我从没奢望过的速度传播我的礼物。— 瘟疫法师罗坦德吉利

card_text.english:
Finger of Death
Active 4: Deal 8 piercing damage to a unit.  Quicken (reduce cooldown by 1, but not below 1).
card_text.schinese:
死亡之指
主动4：对一个单位造成8透甲伤害。加速（减少1冷却，但不会低于1）。

english.CardText_10060: [abilityname[Finger of Death]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■4:]] Deal 8 [g:508[piercing]] damage to a [g:607[unit]].  Quicken (reduce cooldown by 1, but not below 1).]]
english.CardLore_10060: I am a hunted man. The Court of Ristul seek my hand. The Anti-Mage, my head. Now I seek asylum in Weeping Rose, but first I must seek the Quorum's emissary. — Lion, the Demon Witch

schinese.CardText_10060: [abilityname[死亡之指]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■4：]]对一个[g:607[单位]]造成8[g:508[透甲]]伤害。加速（减少1冷却，但不会低于1）。]]
schinese.CardLore_10060: 我一直遭人追捕。瑞斯托王廷想要我的手，敌法师想取我的头。现在我打算去悲玫城寻求庇护，不过首先必须找到评议团密使。— 恶魔巫师莱恩

card_text.english:
Concussive Shot
Active 2: Give a hero and its allied neighbors -2 Armor this round.
card_text.schinese:
震荡光弹
主动2：在本回合使一名英雄及其友方近邻-2护甲。

english.CardText_10062: [abilityname[Concussive Shot]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Give a [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] -2 [g:504[Armor]] this round.]]
english.CardLore_10062: I empathize with Rix. It's not easy following the orders of a leader you despise. But I don't have the luxury of staging a rebellion...the stakes are too high, and so I must bide my time... and wait to be reunited with my beloved. — Dragonus, the Skywrath Mage

schinese.CardText_10062: [abilityname[震荡光弹]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]]在本回合使一名[g:0[英雄]]及其[g:601[友方近邻]]-2[g:504[护甲]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10062: 我能体会瑞克斯的心情。服从自己鄙夷的指挥官可不是件容易的事。但我可没有发起反抗这么奢侈的一个选择……风险太大了；因此，我要等待时机成熟……等待与我爱的人重逢。— 天怒法师扎贡纳斯

card_text.english: Deal 12 damage evenly divided among a unit and its allied neighbors.
card_text.schinese: 造成12伤害。由一个单位及其友方近邻平均分摊。

english.CardText_10063: Deal 12 damage evenly divided among a [g:607[unit]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]].
english.CardLore_10063: I dedicated my life to the pursuit of the mystic arts...But while my head was buried in books, my beloved was betrayed and cast out of the Ghastly Eyrie. I was unable to save her then... but at least I have the power to save her now. — Skywrath Mage, Guilt-Wrecked

schinese.CardText_10063: 造成12伤害。由一个[g:607[单位]]及其[g:601[友方近邻]]平均分摊。
schinese.CardLore_10063: 我花了毕生的精力研习秘术……但在我埋首于书堆时，我心爱之人遭到陷害，被逐出了苍白之巢。在当时我无能为力……但是现在我已拥有足以拯救她的力量。— 满心内疚的天怒法师

card_text.english:
Arcane Aura
After the first time an allied spell is played in each lane, restore 2 Mana to the tower in that lane.
card_text.schinese:
奥术灵气
在各兵线上首次打出友方法术后，该兵线上的塔恢复2魔力。

english.CardText_10064: [abilityname[Arcane Aura]]After the first time an allied [g:4[spell]] is played in each lane, restore 2 [g:511[Mana]] to the [g:2[tower]] in that lane.
english.CardLore_10064: 'Warden of Icewrack.' It's a fancy title. In theory it means I'm responsible for maintaining law and order, collaborating with the Sapphire Conclave on magical crimes, and protecting the weak from all manners of nasty things. In practice I help farmers fix fences. So I decided to go on a little sabbatical. Besides... I couldn't stay in Icewrack. It's cold. It's boring. And I heard my sister was planning on visiting so I definitely had to get the hell outta there. — Rylai, the Crystal Maiden

schinese.CardText_10064: [abilityname[奥术灵气]]在各兵线上首次打出友方[g:4[法术]]后，该兵线上的[g:2[塔]]恢复2[g:511[魔力]]。
schinese.CardLore_10064: 冰川残骸守望者，真是个漂亮的头衔。理论上，维持法律与秩序、和蓝宝石教团合作防堵魔法犯罪、保护弱小不受各种险恶侵害，都是我的职责所在。实际上，我的主要工作内容是帮农民修篱笆，所以我决定帮自己办理停薪留职。再加上……冰川残骸太冷又无聊，我不想继续留在这里了。尤其是当我听说姐姐要来看我，这下子我是走定了。— 冰晶圣女莉莱

english.CardLore_10065: I care little for the affairs of mortals. I have no stake in the war between the Red Mist and the Bronze Legion, and the plight of the Vhoul does little to stir my blood. What I DO care about however, is that charlatan Storm Spirit claiming my lightning as his own... and so I travel to Roseleaf; to prove that there is no god of lightning above me. — Zeus, Lord of Heaven

schinese.CardLore_10065: 凡人俗事我不屑一顾，红雾与古铜军团间的争战与我无关，豺狼人的困境也挑不起我的兴趣。我真正在意的，是那个夸夸其谈的风暴之灵声称我的闪电归他管辖……于是我来到了玫叶城，为的是证明我才是统御闪电的最高神祇。— 天界之王宙斯

english.CardLore_10067: I'm no stranger to man's lust for conquest. To be seen not as a person but as a commodity... and I refuse to stand idly by while the Vhoul are subjugated. It's too late for my people... but it might not be too late for theirs. — Magnus, Endangered Protector

schinese.CardLore_10067: 我对人类征服的欲望并不陌生。在人类欲望的眼中，我们不再是人，而是商品……在豺狼人受到镇压时，我无法再袖手旁观。对我的族人来说一切都已经太迟了……但他们还有希望。— 濒危守护者马格纳斯

card_text.english:
Surge
Active 2: Move another ally to another lane.
card_text.schinese:
奔腾
主动2：将另一个友方单位移至另一条兵线。

english.CardText_10068: [abilityname[Surge]][activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Move another ally to another lane.]]
english.CardLore_10068: The Red Mist slowly marches to Stonehall. The Bronze Legion plans an ambush in Roseleaf. But the denizens of that Vhoul city do not take kindly to occupation and have sparked an insurrection. Three factions. One battlefield. And not a strategic mind between them. I will defeat these charlatans of war. And in doing so, prove my brilliance. — Ish'kafel, the Dark Seer

schinese.CardText_10068: [abilityname[奔腾]][activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]]将另一个友方单位移至另一条兵线。]]
schinese.CardLore_10068: 红雾正在缓慢地向石堂城推进。古铜军团计划在玫叶城进行伏击，但那座豺狼人城市的居民不会给占领者好脸色看，早已发生了暴动。一个战场，三股势力。三者之中没有一个有战略头脑的人。我会击溃这些假充内行的战争贩子，以此证明我的杰出。— 黑暗贤者伊许卡菲尔

card_text.english:
Moment of Courage
Legion Commander has +2 Retaliate.
card_text.schinese:
勇气之霎
军团指挥官+2反伤。

english.CardLore_10069: I know these people think me a monster. I don't blame them. No one wants to be occupied, but it's in their best interests! If we weren't here in Roseleaf the Red Mist would have slaughtered them all... today the Vhoul see us as villains, but after we defeat Sorla Khan... The Bronze Legion will be heralded as the heroes we are. — Tresdin, Legion Commander

schinese.CardLore_10069: 我知道这些人觉得我是个怪物。我不怪他们。没人喜欢被占领，但这一切全都是为了他们好。如果我们没来玫叶城，恐怕红雾已经把他们全部屠杀殆尽……现在这些豺狼人把我们当成大恶人，但等我们击败了索尔拉可汗之后……他们终将承认古铜军团才是真正的英雄。— 军团指挥官特蕾丝汀

card_text.english:
Fury Swipes
When Ursa deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Armor.
card_text.schinese:
怒意狂击
当熊战士对一个单位造成战斗伤害时，修改该单位，使其-1护甲。

english.CardText_10070: [abilityname[Fury Swipes]]When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:504[Armor]].
english.CardLore_10070: This isn't my fight. But if I don't stand with the Vhoul it's only a matter of time before the Bronze Legion comes for my people. A message needs to be sent... and it will be bloody. — Ursa, Tribal Protector

schinese.CardText_10070: [abilityname[怒意狂击]]当{s:thisCardName}对一个[g:607[单位]]造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]时，[g:401[修改]]该[g:607[单位]]，使其-1[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardLore_10070: 这本不是我的战斗，可是，如果我不与豺狼人并肩作战，那么古铜军团迟早会找上我的族人。我们必须向他们传递一个消息……用鲜血写就的消息。— 部落守护者熊战士

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Modify a random allied hero with +2 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：修改一名随机友方英雄，使其+2攻击。

english.CardLore_10076: Greevils were terrible mistake. Smeevils were created to fix mistake. Greevils hurt. Smeevils help. For instance. I make swords that can be used to kill Greevils. And other people. But ideally Greevils. — Kareth, Smeevil Armsmaster

schinese.CardText_10076: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]][g:401[修改]]一名随机友方[g:0[英雄]]，使其+2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10076_0: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]][g:401[修改]]一名随机友方[g:0[英雄]]，使其+2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10076: 贪魔的存在是个大错。而打铁小魔是造出来纠正错误的。贪魔害人。打铁小魔助人。比方说。我制作了可以杀贪魔的剑。也可以用来杀其他人。但还是杀贪魔最合适。— 打铁小魔护甲大师卡雷斯

card_text.english: Active 1: Choose a combat target for Sister of the Veil.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：为幻影之纱刺客选择一个战斗目标。

english.CardLore_10077: My role is not to question, but to act. It doesn't matter if you are a pauper in the street, a king on a throne, or a mad wizard locked away in the Tyler Estate. If your name is given to me by The Veiled Sisters... your death is inevitable. The only question is when will I choose to take it. — Hetheel, Sister of the Veil

schinese.CardLore_10077: 我不质疑，只行动。不管你是街头的穷人、宝座上的国王，抑或是关在泰勒庄园的疯法师。只要魅影之纱姐妹会给了我你的名字……你就必死无疑。只是我何时去取你性命的问题。— 魅影之纱刺客海希尔

card_text.english: The enemy tower has -1 Mana.
card_text.schinese: 敌方塔-1魔力。

english.CardLore_10078: There is no such thing as forbidden magic in Weeping Rose. But some mistake the Quorums...open mindedness... as a license to be irresponsible. The Tyler Estate is what awaits those who would abuse the hospitality Weeping Rose provides. — Votajo, Tyler Estate Censor

schinese.CardLore_10078: 在悲玫城，没有所谓的禁忌魔法一说。有些人却将评议团的……思想开放……误解为可以任意妄为。而滥用悲玫城盛情款待之人，则会落得被打入泰勒庄园的下场。— 泰勒庄园巡检沃塔约

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Modify a random allied hero with +1 Armor.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：修改一名随机友方英雄，使其+1护甲。

english.CardLore_10079: My needs are simple. A hammer. An anvil. And a master who appreciates my skill. The first two are easy to come by. The third is more elusive. Fortunately bad masters have a tendency to die in battle. Some say this is because of flaws in their armor. I say...'prove it?' — Vareth, Smeevil Blacksmith

schinese.CardText_10079: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]][g:401[修改]]一名随机友方[g:0[英雄]]，使其+1[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10079_0: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]][g:401[修改]]一名随机友方[g:0[英雄]]，使其+1[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardLore_10079: 我的要求不高。只求一把锤子。一块铁砧。还有一位赏识我工艺的主人。要拿到前两样很容易。但是第三样就不太好找了。好在坏主人通常都会战死沙场。有人说是因为盔甲有问题。对此我会说……“证据在哪？”— 打铁小魔铁匠瓦雷斯

card_text.english: Active 1: Swap Rebel Decoy with another ally.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：将叛军诱饵与另一个友方单位互换位置。

english.CardLore_10080: I'll never forget the day I met Rix. It was in the early days of the revolution, when people were scared to even gather at night. We met in the tailor's wine cellar and Rix talked... god did he talk. Of passion. Of mistakes. Of his love for our people. I was mesmerized. We all were. So when he turned to me and asked what I could give to help the rebellion, there was only one answer... 'My life.' — Lyla, Rebel Decoy

schinese.CardText_10080: [activatedability[[color:ability[主动■1：]]将{s:thisCardName}与另一个友方单位互换位置。]]
schinese.CardLore_10080: 我永远不会忘记遇到瑞克斯的那一天。那还是革命初期，人们甚至不敢在夜间聚会。我们在裁缝家的地下酒窖密会，然后瑞克斯发表了……他的口才简直是神赐！他谈到热情，谈到错误，谈到对人民的热爱……我被他迷住了。我们大家都被迷住了。所以当他问我愿意为革命付出什么时，我只有一个答案：“我的生命。”— 叛军诱饵莱拉

card_text.english: Modify Pit Fighter of Quoidge with +2 Attack after an allied neighbor dies.
card_text.schinese: 一个友方近邻死亡后，修改囚尸岭绝命斗士，使其+2攻击。

english.CardLore_10083: I get it, I get it, 'The Fields of Endless Carnage' sounds like a horrible place to take a holiday but I'm tellin' you Quoidge is a great city filled with lovely people. If you ever make the trip be sure to stop by the fightin' pits and say hello. I may look different on account of the whole sewing-on-limbs thing but I'll remember you... I never forget a face. — Tristan, Undead Boxer and all around swell chap

schinese.CardText_10083: 一个[g:601[友方近邻]]死亡后，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10083_0: 一个[g:601[友方近邻]]死亡后，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10083: 我懂，我懂，“戮尽之地”听起来不是个适合度假的地方，不过我要告诉你，囚尸岭是个好地方，居民也都很友善。如果你有一天去到那里的话，一定要来一趟角斗场，和我打个招呼。我的四肢经常缝缝补补，外貌可能会跟现在不同，不过我一定会记得你的……我从不会忘记人的长相。— 亡灵拳手大好人特里斯坦

card_text.english: After the combat phase, if Rebel Instigator dealt battle damage to a creep this round, summon a Rebel Instigator.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，如果叛乱煽动者在本回合对一名小兵造成战斗伤害，召唤一名叛乱煽动者。

english.CardText_10084: [g:202[After the combat phase]], if {s:thisCardName} dealt [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:1[creep]] this round, [g:409[summon]] a [[Rebel Instigator]].
english.CardEffect_10084_0: [g:202[After the combat phase]], if {s:thisCardName} dealt [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:1[creep]] this round, [g:409[summon]] a [[Rebel Instigator]].
english.CardLore_10084: I'm not some wide-eyed pup with delusions of being a hero. I know what we're up against, and I know I'll be leaving my wife a widow. But this our home. How can I look my daughter in the eyes and say that when our only chance to free ourselves from the yoke of the bronze legion came I did nothing. That so many of our brothers died for nothing, that maybe things would have been different if I just tried. No. I know what I need to do. And when I'm finished others will as well. — Gorn, Rebel Instigator

schinese.CardText_10084: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，如果{s:thisCardName}在本回合对一名[g:1[小兵]]造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]，[g:409[召唤]]一名[[叛乱煽动者]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10084_0: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，如果{s:thisCardName}在本回合对一名[g:1[小兵]]造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]，[g:409[召唤]]一名[[叛乱煽动者]]。
schinese.CardLore_10084: 我并非单纯无知、幻想当英雄的人。我知道我们对抗的是什么，我也知道我的妻子将从此守寡。但是这是我们的家园。如果要让我正视我的女儿，告诉她，当我们将自己从古铜军团的奴役中解放出来的唯一机会来临之时，我什么也没做；告诉她，无数同胞的血白流了；告诉她，我的尝试本来有可能更改一切。我做不到。我知道我该做什么，而当我牺牲时，会有人继续我的事业的。— 叛乱煽动者戈恩

card_text.english: Siege 5. Assassin's Shadow has -2 Attack for each ally.
card_text.schinese: 攻城5。每有一个友方单位，刺客暗影-2攻击。

english.CardLore_10085: For the most powerful of our order... not even death removes us from our sacred duty. Our communion with the Phantom Veil is strong enough to let our spirit live on, long after our bodies have rot. The mortal coil is now behind me, and the presence of my sisters, while comforting, is a distraction from the work I must do. My list still has names on it...and I won't rest until they are dead. — Elsbeth, the Assassin's Shadow

schinese.CardText_10085: [g:501[攻城]]5。每有一个友方单位，{s:thisCardName}-2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10085_0: 每有一个友方单位，{s:thisCardName}-2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10085: 为了姐妹会中最崇高的存在……即使是死亡也解除不了我们的神圣职责。我们与魅影之纱水乳交融，哪怕我们的血肉之躯已腐，灵魂也会长存。我早已将世间纷扰丢在脑后，而姐妹们的相伴虽然能抚慰心灵，但是也使我分心，无法专注于我的使命。我的名单上还有名字……他们不死我誓不罢休。— 刺客暗影艾斯贝斯

card_text.english: Other allies have +2 Attack and -2 Armor.
card_text.schinese: 其他友方单位+2攻击和-2护甲。

english.CardLore_10086: There is delicious conflict here. And where there is conflict there is desperation. And where there is desperation there is blood to be shed and deals to be made. — Zo, Disciple of Nevermore

schinese.CardLore_10086: 这里的冲突美妙异常。有冲突就会有绝境，有绝境就会有流血，还有随之而来的交易。— 奈文摩尔的信徒邹

card_text.english: Legion Standard Bearer's allied neighbors have +4 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 军团旗手的友方近邻+4攻击。

english.CardLore_10087: As a boy I dreamed of being a member of the Stonehall Elite... to be trained by Belasanno himself in the ways of war... but the sad truth is that I have no gift for combat. I am no soldier. But I am a believer. In our emperor. In our country. In our mission. I may not be a swordsman, but I am proud to carry the bullsnake into battle. — Pololo, Standard Bearer of the Bronze Legion

schinese.CardLore_10087: 我从小就梦想成为石堂城精英的一份子……让贝拉萨诺亲自训练我作战……但不幸的是，我没有一丝一毫的战斗天赋。我不是战士，但是我有一颗虔诚的心，相信着我们的大帝、我们的国家、我们的任务。我或许不能使枪弄棒，但是我能在战场上高举牛头蛇的旗帜，我感到非常自豪。— 古铜军团旗手波洛罗

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Give Relentless Zombie a Death Shield.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：使不屈僵尸获得免死护盾。

english.CardLore_10090: The dead are rising in Roseleaf, Knogh...someone took The Oath. — Vanessa, Heretic for Hire

schinese.CardLore_10090: 诺格，玫叶城里死人复生……有人立下了誓约。— 异教徒雇佣兵凡妮莎

card_text.english: Revtel Convoy has +X Attack where X is equal to half your gold.
card_text.schinese: 瑞文泰尔护卫队+X攻击，X为你持有金钱的一半。

english.CardText_10091: {s:thisCardName} has +X [g:509[Attack]] where X is equal to half your gold.
english.CardEffect_10091_0: {s:thisCardName} has +X [g:509[Attack]] where X is equal to half your gold.
english.CardLore_10091: These are strange times in Revtel. Iron Fog is terrorized by Losel. The Veiled Sisters assassinated Kwerthias. And Lord Sunbreeze's own daughter has burned down his estate. But despite the setbacks, the wheel continues to turn and profits continue to roll in. But there is no time to mourn in Revtel... there is business to be done. — Lowenplatt, Merchant of Revtel

schinese.CardLore_10091: 瑞文泰尔现在处于一个奇怪的时期，铁雾被罗塞尔的威胁笼罩。魅影之纱姐妹会暗杀了奎堤亚斯。晴风领主的亲生女儿烧毁了他的庄园。但是在种种挫折中，财富之轮依然运转，获利依然不减。没时间在瑞文泰尔哀悼了……还有生意要做。— 瑞文泰尔商人洛文普拉特

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Deal 4 damage to the enemy tower.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：对敌方塔造成4伤害。

english.CardText_10092: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  Deal 4 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].
english.CardEffect_10092_0: [color:play_effect[[g:602[Play Effect]]:]]  Deal 4 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]].
english.CardLore_10092: Besiege Stonehall. I've seen Khan's over thrown for even suggesting it. But when Sorla gave the order, not one of us batted an eye. Not because she's the strongest. Not because we fear her cruelty. But because we knew that she would die before she failed her people. And so The Red Mist marches... and may the gods have mercy on whoever stands in our way. — Seguri, Red Mist Vandal

schinese.CardText_10092: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]]对敌方[g:2[塔]]造成4伤害。
schinese.CardEffect_10092_0: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]]对敌方[g:2[塔]]造成4伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10092: 围攻石堂城，有些可汗光是提议一句，就丢了宝座。但是当索尔拉下令时，我们连眼睛都没有眨一下。并不是因为她的强大，也不是因为我们惧怕她的残酷，而是因为我们知道她宁死都不会让她的人民失望。于是红雾部落踏上征程……希望诸神能够怜悯阻挡我们的人。— 红雾破坏者瑟古利

english.CardLore_10093: They smell blood, but what they track is fear. — Kanna, Dire Child

schinese.CardLore_10093: 他们能闻到血的味道，但他们要追寻的是恐惧，— 夜魇之女卡娜

card_text.english: Active 2: Spend all your gold. Modify Mercenary Exiles with +X Attack and +X Health where X is half the gold spent.
card_text.schinese: 主动2：消耗你所有的金钱。修改亡命佣兵，使其+X攻击和+X生命，X为消耗金钱的一半。

english.CardText_10094: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■2:]] Spend all your gold. [g:401[Modify]] {s:thisCardName} with +X [g:509[Attack]] and +X [g:510[Health]] where X is half the gold spent.]]
english.CardLore_10094: We were good soldiers that served Galanius and the Bronze Legion for years. The blood we spilt didn't just bring glory to Stonehall, it helped build the whole damn empire. And how were we rewarded? With a fancy piece of red cloth to wear into battle. But you can't build a keep out of honor. You can't feed your family with Pride. You can't repay a debt with Glory. So now we fight for the only thing that matters. Gold. — Tessgan, leader of the Black Hilt Mercenary Company

schinese.CardText_10094: [activatedability[[color:ability[主动■2：]]消耗你所有的金钱。[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+X[g:509[攻击]]和+X[g:510[生命]]，X为消耗金钱的一半。]]
schinese.CardLore_10094: 我们为加拉尼乌斯和古铜军团浴血奋战多年，我们流的血不只为石堂城带来荣耀，也造就了一整个该死的帝国。可是我们得到了什么回报？一小块可以披着继续上战场的漂亮红布。但是，光有荣誉建不出堡垒。光有自豪养不活家人。光有光荣还不清债务。所以现在我们只为唯一有价值的东西而战：金钱。— 黑柄雇佣兵团团长特斯刚

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Discard your hand.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：舍弃你的手牌。

english.CardLore_10095: Mazzie is horrible at lots of things. Being dependable. Staying sober. Keeping secrets. But I'll give him credit: he knows how to build a giant robot. — Tinker, Humbled Inventor

schinese.CardLore_10095: 梅兹在许多事情上都糟糕透顶。比如不可靠，很难保持清醒，又不能保守秘密。但我还是得夸夸他：他懂得如何建造巨型机器人。— 谦逊的发明家修补匠

card_text.english: Active 1: Modify allies with +2 Attack and +2 Health.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：修改友方单位，使其+2攻击和+2生命。

english.CardLore_10096: The more judgmental call Weeping Rose a place where magic is unfettered by morality... a chaotic city of delights and horrors. And they would be partially right. The city was founded on the idea that 'good magic' and 'evil magic' are labels created by lesser minds... But there is no chaos in Weeping Rose... The Quorum ensures that is the case. And it is on their behalf that I have traveled here. — The Emissary of the Quorum

schinese.CardText_10096: [activatedability[[color:ability[主动■1：]][g:401[修改]]友方单位，使其+2[g:509[攻击]]和+2[g:510[生命]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10096: 在无理武断的人眼中，悲玫城是个魔法不受道德束缚之地，是个喜乐恐惧并存的混乱之城。他们这么认为也是有几分道理；因为这座城市的创建理念是只有片面浅薄之人，才会用“好魔法”与“坏魔法”这样的标签来作分辨。事实上，悲玫城并不混乱……这一点由评议团在确保著。我正是代表着他们而来到此地。— 评议团密使

english.CardLore_10097: Every year my clan comes to Roseleaf for the Thunderhide migration... and while the denizens of Roseleaf were a minor nuisance we never bothered to hunt them... they were too frail to make a worthy trophy. But now things have changed. This 'Rix' has stirred their blood and now they fancy themselves warriors... perhaps it's time to start a new hunt. — Mavor, Marrowfell Brawler

schinese.CardLore_10097: 我的部落每年都会在雷肤兽迁徙时来玫叶城……尽管玫叶城的居民有点烦人，但是我们一直懒得猎杀他们……他们太弱了，根本算不上什么有价值的战利品。但是时过境迁，这个叫瑞克斯的人让他们血脉贲张，现在他们自称战士……也许该开始新的猎捕行动了。— 断骨格斗士玛沃尔

card_text.english: Siege 6.
card_text.schinese: 攻城6。

english.CardLore_10102: When hunting Thunderhides, you always come home with new scars...if you come home at all. — Warrunner warns his hunters

schinese.CardLore_10102: 猎杀雷肤兽，你总会挂点彩回来……如果你还能活着回来的话。— 战行者对猎手的警告

card_text.english: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower after an allied Melee Creep dies.
card_text.schinese: 一名友方近战小兵死亡后，对敌方塔造成2透甲伤害。

english.CardText_10103: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] after an allied [[Melee Creep]] dies.
english.CardEffect_10103_0: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] after an allied [[Melee Creep]] dies.
english.CardLore_10103: Friends said throwing dead bodies was hobby, not real job. Who's laughing now? Not friends. I kill them for not supporting my dream. — Lommett, Ogre Corpse Tosser

schinese.CardText_10103: 一名友方[[近战小兵]]死亡后，对敌方[g:2[塔]]造成2[g:508[透甲]]伤害。
schinese.CardEffect_10103_0: 一名友方[[近战小兵]]死亡后，对敌方[g:2[塔]]造成2[g:508[透甲]]伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10103: 我朋友说丢尸体顶多只能算是个嗜好，不是份正当工作。但看看现在是谁笑到了最后？不是我那些朋友。他们不支持我的梦想，我把他们都毙了。— 食人魔投尸手洛麦特

english.CardLore_10104: The Red Mist Horde is on the march, looting and destroying every city that stands between them and our great capital of Stonehall. If we wish to protect our home...if we wish to stop these monsters... we must be willing to do whatever it takes. — Decius, Bronze Legionnaire

schinese.CardLore_10104: 红雾部落正在向我们伟大的首都石堂城进军，一路烧杀劫掠，沿途的城镇无一幸免。为了保护我们的家园……我们必须不惜一切代价。— 古铜军团士兵德西乌斯

card_text.english: Fully restore your tower's Mana after you play any card.
card_text.schinese: 打出任意卡牌后，你的塔恢复全部魔力。

english.CardText_10106: Fully restore your [g:2[tower]]'s [g:511[Mana]] after you play any card.
english.CardEffect_10106_0: Fully restore your [g:2[tower]]'s [g:511[Mana]] after you play any card.
english.CardLore_10106: Like any mother, I've had to watch as harm befalls my children... hoping that by not intervening they would learn how to navigate this cruel and unfeeling world. But sometimes... sometimes the cries of my beloved are too loud for me not to answer — Selemene, Godess of the Moon

schinese.CardText_10106: 打出任意卡牌后，你的[g:2[塔]]恢复全部[g:511[魔力]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10106_0: 打出任意卡牌后，你的[g:2[塔]]恢复全部[g:511[魔力]]。
schinese.CardLore_10106: 跟所有母亲一样，当我的孩子碰到些磕磕撞撞时，我会在一旁边袖手旁观，希望如此能让他们学会在残酷无情的世界中生存。但是有时候……有时候，当我亲爱的孩子们哭号得过度悲戚，我便不得不出面。— 月之女神赛莉蒙妮

card_text.english: Death Effect:  Modify allies with +1 Attack and +1 Health.
card_text.schinese: 死亡效果：修改友方单位，使其+1攻击和+1生命。

english.CardLore_10107: I knew this day would come the moment I agreed to host Rix's gatherings in my wine cellar... but I wasn't ready for what it felt like to be pulled from my home in the middle of the night. I know it's only a matter of time before Tresdin has me executed, and I won't lie. I'm scared. But we all have our parts to play. — Papa Samet, Vhoul Martyr

schinese.CardText_10107: [color:death_effect[[g:603[死亡效果]]：]][g:401[修改]]友方单位，使其+1[g:509[攻击]]和+1[g:510[生命]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10107_0: [color:death_effect[[g:603[死亡效果]]：]][g:401[修改]]友方单位，使其+1[g:509[攻击]]和+1[g:510[生命]]。
schinese.CardLore_10107: 当我同意让瑞克斯在我的地下酒窖里召集人手时，我就知道会有这一天……但是半夜被迫离家这件事，我并没有心理准备。我知道特蕾丝汀早晚会处决我，说实话，我很害怕。但是我们各自都有必须要扮演的角色。— 豺狼人殉道者萨梅老爹

english.CardLore_10108: The Alpha is a fearsome beast, capable of untold destruction... only the strongest of centaurs dare to stand in its presence, let alone fight it one on one. — Warrunner on the trail of the Alpha

schinese.CardLore_10108: 雷肤兽领袖凶狠可怕，有着无与伦比的毁灭力……就是最强大的半人马也仅胆敢接近它，更别说是想一对一对峙了。— 战行者追踪雷肤兽首领

card_text.english: Modify Satyr Duelist with +2 Attack after the combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，修改萨特决斗家，使其+2攻击。

english.CardLore_10111: I am not a swordsman. I am artist. Now, I'm not foolish enough to boast that none are my equal, after all the world is filled with exceptional individuals...but I am wise enough to know that I am better than most. — Trivian, the Satyr Duelist

schinese.CardLore_10111: 我不是剑士，我是艺术家。但是，我没那么愚蠢，会称自己天下无敌，毕竟这个世界到处是杰出人才……但是，我够聪慧，知道自己比大部分人厉害。— 萨特决斗家崔维安

card_text.english: Modify Savage Wolf with +1 Attack and +2 Health after the combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，修改野蛮灵狼，使其+1攻击和+2生命。

english.CardLore_10112: My family was taken from me; but in my solitude I found a new family... and they will help me have my revenge. — Lycan, Pack Leader

schinese.CardText_10112: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+1[g:509[攻击]]和+2[g:510[生命]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10112_0: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其+1[g:509[攻击]]和+2[g:510[生命]]。
schinese.CardLore_10112: 我失去了家人，但在独行的日子里又找到了新的家人……他们会助我复仇。— 狼群领袖狼人

card_text.english: Modify Rampaging Hellbear with +4 Attack after the combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，修改暴走地狱熊怪，使其+4攻击。

english.CardLore_10113: Kwerthias took great pride in his menagerie, though ultimately it led to his undoing. The Phantom Assassin unleashed his pets in the palace... while his guards were focused on his beasts... she slit his throat. — The Brass Herald giving respect where it is due

schinese.CardLore_10113: 奎堤亚斯的动物园让他引以为傲，但也最终导致了他的灭亡。幻影刺客将他宫中的宠物都放了出来……当他的士卫们在专心应付那些猛兽时……她切开了他的喉咙。— 黄铜先锋实话实说

card_text.english: Summon a Zombie for your opponent after the combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，为你的对手召唤一具僵尸。

english.CardText_10114: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] for your opponent [g:202[after the combat phase]].
english.CardEffect_10114_0: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Zombie]] for your opponent [g:202[after the combat phase]].
english.CardLore_10114: I'm not proud of what I've done, we were children playing games... how could I've expected what would come, what she was willing to awaken. Death is coming for us all now... but it is most certainly coming for me first. — Giamma, the Cursed Satyr

schinese.CardText_10114: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，为你的对手[g:409[召唤]]一具[[僵尸]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10114_0: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，为你的对手[g:409[召唤]]一具[[僵尸]]。
schinese.CardLore_10114: 我并不以我的所作所为为荣，那只是小孩子之间的戏耍……我怎么会预料到，怎么会知道她要唤醒何物。死亡即将笼罩大地……我一定会先遭殃。— 被诅咒的萨特吉亚玛

card_text.english: Active 1: Condemn a random item equipped by the unit blocking Ravenhook. Get gold equal to the base cost of that item.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：惩处阻挡勾财黑鸦的单位装备的一件随机物品。获得与该物品基础价格相等的金钱。

english.CardText_10115: [activatedability[[color:ability[Active ■1:]] [g:408[Condemn]] a random [g:5[item]] equipped by the [g:607[unit]] blocking {s:thisCardName}. Get gold equal to the base cost of that [g:5[item]].]]
english.CardLore_10115: I'm not oblivious to the reputation I have; after all, the visits my brothers and sisters make are... rarely social. But it's not my fault I'm here, it's yours. Maybe you stole from your noble father... perhaps you defaulted on a Revtel debt... or could it be something as pedestrian as revenge... Eh, who's to say, the 'whys' don't matter do they? No. All that matters is that there is something you hold dear, and my employer wants me to take it from you. — Jorbiah, the Ravenhook

schinese.CardText_10115: [activatedability[[color:ability[主动■1：]][g:408[惩处]]阻挡{s:thisCardName}的[g:607[单位]]装备的一件随机[g:5[物品]]。获得与该[g:5[物品]]基础价格相等的金钱。]]
schinese.CardLore_10115: 我当然知道自己的名声如何。毕竟我的兄弟姐妹们上门来时……通常都不是为了结交朋友。但现在我人在这里又不是我的错，而是你的。也许你从你的贵族老爹那偷了什么家当……也许你没还清瑞文泰尔的债……又或者这是什么复仇之类的老掉牙戏码……呃，谁知道呢，反正原因并不重要，对吧？重要的是你有个你很宝贝的东西，是我的雇主想从你那拿走的。— 勾财黑鸦乔比亚

card_text.english: Active 1: Condemn Ravenous Mass's allied neighbors. Modify Ravenous Mass with their Attack and Health.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：惩处贪婪众生的友方近邻。修改贪婪众生，使其获得那些单位的攻击和生命。

english.CardLore_10116: In the Fields of Endless Carnage, the dead can never die... leading to the creation of grotesque perversions such as these. — Lady Anshu expresses her scorn

schinese.CardText_10116: [activatedability[[color:ability[主动■1：]][g:408[惩处]]{s:thisCardName}的[g:601[友方近邻]]。[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其获得那些单位的[g:509[攻击]]和[g:510[生命]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10116: 在戮尽之地，亡者永远无法安息……因此造就了这群奇异丑陋的怪物。— 安苏夫人表达她的蔑视

card_text.english: Your tower has +1 Mana.
card_text.schinese: 你的塔+1魔力。

english.CardLore_10117: To fight alongside Rooftrellen is a great honor. With his help I have no doubt that these trespassers will be removed in no time. But even still, sometimes I am filled with doubt. Today it is the Red Mist and Bronze Legion. Tomorrow it will be the keen. When will the despoiling of our home ever end... — Aubgraw, Roseleaf Druid

schinese.CardLore_10117: 能与鲁夫特伦并肩作战是莫大的荣耀。有了他的帮助，我确信能立即驱逐掉这些入侵者。但，有时我会怀疑，今天是红雾与古铜军团，明天可能就会是基恩人了。什么时候我们的家园才不会再受到侵犯……。— 玫叶德鲁伊奥布格罗

card_text.english: When Hellbear Crippler deals battle damage to a unit, modify that unit with -1 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 当地狱熊怪摧残者对一个单位造成战斗伤害时，修改该单位，使其-1攻击。

english.CardText_10118: When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].
english.CardEffect_10118_0: When {s:thisCardName} deals [g:609[battle damage]] to a [g:607[unit]], [g:401[modify]] that [g:607[unit]] with -1 [g:509[Attack]].
english.CardLore_10118: Any centaur worth his skinning knife can kill a Hellbear. The real trick is doing it without getting scarred. — Bradwarden remains unimpressed

schinese.CardText_10118: 当{s:thisCardName}对一个[g:607[单位]]造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]时，[g:401[修改]]该[g:607[单位]]，使其-1[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardEffect_10118_0: 当{s:thisCardName}对一个[g:607[单位]]造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]时，[g:401[修改]]该[g:607[单位]]，使其-1[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10118: 任何一个配得上手中剥皮刀的半人马都可以杀死一头地狱熊怪。但是还要保证自己不受伤就需要技巧了。— 不屑一顾的布兰德瓦登

card_text.english: Fully heal Selfish Cleric after the combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，完整治疗自私教士。

english.CardLore_10119: For generations the Rumusque Faithful have defended the living world from the abominations that slink from the Fields of Endless Carnage. We were known as men and women of principle. Of valor. Of Devotion. And then Necrophos tried to destroy us all. — Abajen, Rumusque Cleric

schinese.CardLore_10119: 世代以来，鲁姆斯克的信徒保护着这个生灵的世界，抵御了无数从戮尽之地潜逃出来的邪物怪灵。我们坚守原则、勇猛无畏、虔诚奉献。然而瘟疫法师却想将我们消灭殆尽。— 鲁姆斯克牧师阿贝金

english.CardLore_10127: The Bronze Legion brings peace, the stupid Vhoul bring chaos. Like Rix I joined the Legion. Unlike Rix I'm loyal. Soon the rebellion will be finished, perhaps then Commander Tresdin will let me eat Vhoul. — Tox Armripper, Bronze Legion Conscript

schinese.CardLore_10127: 古铜军团会带来和平，愚蠢的豺狼人只会带来混乱。我和瑞克斯一样加入了军团，但是与瑞克斯不同，我忠心耿耿。叛乱会很快结束，或许到时候特蕾丝汀指挥官会准我把豺狼人吃了。— 古铜军团应征兵托克斯·断臂者

english.CardLore_10128: I know my parents feel betrayed that I left with the Red Mist. My path was set to be an artisan... but they didn't see Sorla Khan stand in the marketplace. They didn't hear her talk about the old ways. About how the Red Mist isn't about destroying the past but protecting it. Honoring it. Together we're going to build a better future for the Oglodi. — Nalon, the Untested Grunt

schinese.CardLore_10128: 我跟着红雾离开时，我知道我父母觉得我背叛了他们。他们觉得我应该当个工匠……但他们没有看到索尔拉可汗站在市集上的样子。他们没有听到她宣扬上古之道，说红雾为了抹灭过去，而是保护过去、尊重过去。我们一起，将为高地人开创更美好的未来。— 未经考验的士兵纳隆

card_text.english: Active 1: Choose a combat target for Assassin's Apprentice.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：为刺客学徒选择一个战斗目标。

english.CardLore_10129: The Revtel campaign was successful, but I was only there to observe, not take part... they say I'm not ready to kill on my own... but I'll prove them wrong. — Myrian, the Assassin's Apprentice

schinese.CardLore_10129: 瑞文泰尔战役大获全胜，但我只能旁观，没能参与……他们说我还没准备好，不能独立刺杀……我会证明他们说错了。— 刺客学徒米瑞安

card_text.schinese: 当阻挡其前的单位死亡后，修改石堂城精英，使其获得+2攻击和+2生命。

english.CardLore_10131: The Bronze Legion is Stonehall's first line of defense. But sometimes the threats to our great nation don't come from external forces... they come from within. Situations like Rix's betrayal are why Belasanno formed the Stonehall Elite, and it will be my privilege to end this rebellion. — Tyber, member of the Stonehall Elite

schinese.CardText_10131: 当阻挡其前的[g:607[单位]]死亡后，[g:401[修改]]{s:thisCardName}，使其获得+2[g:509[攻击]]和+2[g:510[生命]]。

schinese.CardLore_10131: 古铜军团是石堂城的第一道防线，但是有些时候对我们伟大国家的威胁不是来自外部……而是源于内部。瑞克斯的背叛让贝拉萨诺组织了石堂城精英。结束这次叛乱将是我的荣幸。— 石堂城精英泰博尔

card_text.english: After the combat phase, if Red Mist Pillager dealt battle damage to a tower this round, summon a Red Mist Pillager.
card_text.schinese: 战斗阶段后，如果红雾掠夺者在本回合对一座塔造成战斗伤害，召唤一名红雾掠夺者。

english.CardLore_10132: The Bronze Legion thinks they can stop us at Roseleaf, but already the cracks are showing. Tresdin is delusional if she thinks she can fight Rix's rebellion and the Red Mist. No. Stonehall will fall. It's only a matter of time. — Mial, Red Mist Pillager

schinese.CardText_10132: [g:202[战斗阶段后]]，如果{s:thisCardName}在本回合对一座[g:2[塔]]造成[g:609[战斗伤害]]，[g:409[召唤]]一名[[红雾掠夺者]]。

schinese.CardLore_10132: 古铜军团以为他们能在玫叶城挡下我们，但他们的颓势已现。如果特蕾丝汀觉得自己能同时对付瑞克斯叛军和红雾，那肯定是在痴心妄想。根本不可能。石堂城必将陨落，只是早晚而已。— 红雾掠夺者米埃尔

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Modify Champion of the Ancient with +1 Attack, +1 Health, and +1 Cleave for each enemy.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：每有一个敌人，修改遗迹卫士，使其+1攻击、+1生命和+1顺势。

english.CardLore_10133: My people have pledged their lives in service to the ancient... offering ourselves to be a tide of flesh that will protect the Radiant from Kanna and her Dire heretics. Thanks to the blessing of the Radiant, I have become the crashing wave of that tide... and I will give the Dire something to fear. — Breno, the Champion of the Ancient

schinese.CardLore_10133: 许多人为了遗迹而献出了生命……将自己化为血肉之海，保护天辉不受卡娜和其夜魇异教徒的侵害。感谢天辉的庇佑，我成为了血肉之海的怒涛……我，会让夜魇恐惧我的存在。— 遗迹卫士布雷诺

card_text.english: Play Effect:  Heal your tower 7.
card_text.schinese: 出牌效果：对你的塔进行7治疗。

english.CardLore_10134: The Treants of Roseleaf and the Vhoul have lived together peacefully for generations. But now interlopers have turned our home into a battlefield. We have made the call to our cousins in the Vale of Augery. The vhoul must be protected... and those that would despoil this place must be destroyed. — Springwind, the Roseleaf Rejuvenator

schinese.CardText_10134: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]]对你的[g:2[塔]]进行7治疗。
schinese.CardEffect_10134_0: [color:play_effect[[g:602[出牌效果]]：]]对你的[g:2[塔]]进行7治疗。
schinese.CardLore_10134: 玫叶城的树精与豺狼人们世代和平相处，但是现在这些入侵者把我们的家园变成了战场。我们向预兆之谷的表亲们发出请求，让他们务必保护豺狼人……还有，必须摧毁那些掠夺这片净地的人。— 玫叶神医春风

english.CardLore_10136: This forest has been my home for many years... and its denizens are quick to come to my aid. — Beastmaster, Friend of the Forest

schinese.CardLore_10136: 多年来，我以这座丛林为家……林中的居民非常乐意帮助我。— 森林之友兽王

card_text.english: Active 1: Fully restore your tower's Mana.
card_text.schinese: 主动1：使你的塔恢复全部魔力。

english.CardLore_10137: Power. Immortality. Revenge. These are the three biggest reasons people seek mastery of the arcane arts. But they are not my reasons. I pursue magic because it makes anything possible... and if anything is possible then hope, no matter how remote, can never die. — Allegra, Satyr Magician

schinese.CardText_10137: [activatedability[[color:ability[主动■1：]]使你的[g:2[塔]]恢复全部[g:511[魔力]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10137: 力量、不朽、复仇——人们追求奥术秘法的三大原因。但这都不是我的缘由。我追求魔法只是为了化腐朽为神奇……只要一切皆有可能，那么无论多微弱的希望之火都不会熄灭。— 萨特魔法师阿列格拉

card_text.english: Draw an extra card each round.
card_text.schinese: 每回合多抽一张牌。

english.CardEffect_10138_0: Draw a card before the card draw phase.
english.CardLore_10138: The Red Mist Horde is just the beginning. Another force is coming. I've felt it in the winds and seen it in the bones. Something Dark. Something Seductive. Something Evil. If we don't prepare for its arrival, it will certainly consume us all. — Ruseth, Troll Soothsayer

schinese.CardLore_10138: 红雾部落只是开端而已，还有其他势力正在聚集。我在风中感受到了，也在占卜中读到了。黑暗、诱惑、邪恶之物。如果我们不做好抵御准备，它将吞噬我们所有人。— 巨魔预言家鲁塞斯

card_text.english: All heroes have +4 Siege.
card_text.schinese: 所有英雄+4攻城。

english.CardLore_10141: The difference between victory and defeat is the willingness to make unconscionable choices and sacrifice everything. — Sorla Khan, Destroyer

schinese.CardLore_10141: 胜利与失败之间的差别就在于是否能够做出无情的选择，是否愿意牺牲一切。— 毁灭者索尔拉可汗

card_text.english: Condemn all equipped items.
card_text.schinese: 惩处所有已装备的物品。

english.CardLore_10142: I am able to thrive in... less hospitable environs. — Viper, Ultimate Survivor

schinese.CardLore_10142: 我非常能适应……不是那么友好的环境。— 终极生存者冥界亚龙

english.CardLore_10148: I respect the Claszureme Treaty and the human wizard that helped broker it. As such I would never rewrite time for my own amusement... however, I think it's healthy to remind the Sapphire Conclave what I am capable of; lest they grow complacent and fail to live up to their end of the bargain. — Faceless Void, Lord of Claszureme

schinese.CardText_10148: [g:200[行动阶段前]]，使对手的一张随机手牌+1[g:407[锁定]]。

english.CardLore_10149: For so long I was afraid to return home...but the time has come to confront the past. — Lycan, Last Son of House Ambry

english.CardLore_10150: What if I told you that there is always a better solution than the one immediately before you. That horrific wars could have been avoided with negotiation or the strategic removal of individuals. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Cunning. — Jolixia assesses The Murderer

schinese.CardLore_10150: 如果我告诉你，对你来说最直接有效率的解决办法并不是最好的解决办法，会怎么样？通过协商或有策略地消灭关键人物，往往可以避免可怕的战争。如果你觉得我说的话有道理……也许你就该走上诈者之路。— 乔莉希亚评估谋杀者

english.CardLore_10151: What if I told you that most are not fit to lead. That to rule effectively you need to be willing to keep secrets from your own people, and that sentimentality makes you unable to make the right decisions when stakes are high. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Wise. — Jolixia assesses The Warden

schinese.CardLore_10151: 如果我告诉你，绝大多数人不适合做领袖，会怎么样？要想有效地领导别人，就要能够对自己人保持秘密，而如果过于情绪化，就无法在危急时刻做出正确的决定。如果你觉得我说的话有道理……也许你就该走上智者之路。— 乔莉希亚评估守望者

english.CardLore_10152: What if I told you that we don't have to accept the world as it is? That people all too often confuse 'the difficult' with 'the impossible' and in doing so close their minds and hearts to wondrous possibilities. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Dreamer. — Jolixia assesses The Scholar

schinese.CardText_10152: 打出一张[color:green[绿色卡牌]]后，你的[g:2[塔]]+3[g:505[恢复]]，直至回合结束为止。

That there are some people who are destined for greatness, and it is through their skill, dedication, and will that great works are accomplished. If what I said rings true to you... perhaps you should walk The Path of the Bold. — Jolixia assesses The Adventurer

schinese.CardLore_10153: 如果我告诉你，并非每个人都与众不同，会怎么样？世上有些人注定会成就大业，而他们凭借的是自己的技术、决心与意志。如果你觉得我说的话有道理……也许你就该走上勇者之路。— 乔莉希亚评估冒险者

card_text.english: Both towers have -2 Mana.
card_text.schinese: 双方的塔-2魔力。

english.CardLore_10154: Most of the magical world acknowledges the authority of the Sapphire Conclave. But in Weeping Rose we govern ourselves, answering only to The Quorum, a senate of 31 powerful wizards. And while Weeping Rose is not home to many rules, the few we have are obeyed without question. Because to fail to do so is to be sent to the Tyler Estate. — Vanessa, 'law abiding' citizen of Weeping Rose

schinese.CardLore_10154: 几乎整个魔法世界都承认蓝宝石教团的权威，但在悲玫城，我们自己管理自己，只听命于由三十一位强大法师议员所组成的评议团。尽管悲玫城没有那么多繁文缛节，但是仍然有几项我们必须严守的规定，一旦违反就会被送去泰勒庄园。— 悲玫城“守法”公民凡妮莎

And while there is good money in murder, there’s also a lot of effort in it and I’m a busy man. So, if you were to say, hire the Jasper Circle to smuggle you out of town safely, I would be forced to tell the gentleman whom I’m meeting tonight that my services are already under retainer. Regardless of what you choose, our paths will cross again this evening... but the circumstances of that visit are entirely up to you. — Lorlin Lasan, Leader of the Jasper Circle

Well, "willing" is relative, some try to make a run for it and are tied down screaming, but generally they're all on board. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

schinese.CardLore_10222: 在噬血之峰，大祭司们为向剥皮双子献祭而穿上了这些背心。这些祭司非常虔诚，如果找不到能让双子满意的牺牲品，那他们会愿意自我献身。 不过，“愿意”只是相对的，有的人会试图逃跑，最后尖叫着被捆好，不过一般情况来说，他们都会乖乖就范。— 卡牌牧神乔莉希亚

english.CardLore_10223: Long ago, the Oglodi capital was a shining beacon of art and philosophy... and then they met the Tarnsmen. A barbarous group of demon worshipers, the Tarns lay siege to the Oglodi's great city, sating their bloodlust on any they could find. It was a massacre. The battle ended, only because the Tarns grew bored... and left a great civilization in ashes. Ever a resilient people, the Oglodi rebuilt and started again... referring to the razing of their capital as 'The Bleak Day'. But for some rebuilding was not enough. They believed that forsaking the martial in favor of the esoteric is what led to their down fall... and so they left and formed the first Red Mist Horde. — Jolixia, The Card Faun

schinese.CardLore_10223: 很久以前，高地人的都城是引领艺术与哲学发展的闪亮灯塔……直到千湖斗士来到这里，这是一群崇拜恶魔的野蛮人，他们围攻高地人的伟大城市，屠戮所见的一切以满足他们的嗜血欲望。那是一场大屠杀，只不过因为千湖斗士们觉得无聊了，战斗才终于结束……而伟大的文明却化为了灰烬。高地人是个坚韧的民族，他们又一次开始重建复兴……他们将都城遭受浩劫的日子称为“暗日”。但对一些高地人来说，重建家园是不够的。他们相信，重文轻武是导致溃败的根源……所以他们离开家乡，组建了第一支红雾部落。— 卡牌牧神乔莉希亚
