schinese.CardLore_10290: 别叫它背包。— 不承认现实的潮汐猎人

card_text.english: Before the action phase, if there are charges on March of the Machines, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy tower and 2 damage to each enemy.
card_text.schinese: 行动阶段前，如果机械行军有能量，移除1能量，对敌方塔和所有敌人各造成2伤害。

english.CardText_10291: [g:200[Before the action phase]], if there are charges on {s:thisCardName}, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] and 2 damage to each enemy.
english.CardEffect_10291_0: [g:200[Before the action phase]], if there are charges on {s:thisCardName}, remove one and deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] and 2 damage to each enemy.
english.CardLore_10291: Every Keenfolk has a pet obsession. Sniper likes shooting things. Timbersaw cuts down trees. I develop fun and exciting ways to kill Mazzie. Some might frown at my attempted murder, but if I never developed these drones, he never would have built his robot suit to hide in. So really, he should be thanking me. — Tinker, No Friend Of Mazzie

schinese.CardText_10291: [g:200[行动阶段前]]，如果{s:thisCardName}有能量，移除1能量，对敌方[g:2[塔]]和所有敌人各造成2伤害。
schinese.CardEffect_10291_0: [g:200[行动阶段前]]，如果{s:thisCardName}有能量，移除1能量，对敌方[g:2[塔]]和所有敌人各造成2伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10291: 每个基恩人都有一项钟爱的嗜好，狙击手喜欢射击、伐木机喜欢砍树、我喜欢设计刺激又好玩的方式谋杀梅兹。有些人可能不欣赏我的谋杀诡计，但如果不是我开发了这些无人机，他也不会造出可以躲进去的机器人装甲。所以，他其实应该要感谢我。— 跟梅兹不是好朋友的修补匠

card_text.english: Give a red hero +8 Attack and -8 Armor this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使一名红色英雄+8攻击和-8护甲。

english.CardLore_10292: In battle, as in life; there are moments where you are forced to choose between greatness and security. — Warrunner, Fearless Warrior

schinese.CardText_10292: 在本回合使一名[color:red[红色[g:0[英雄]]]]+8[g:509[攻击]]和-8[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardLore_10292: 战斗中跟在生活中一样；有时候你得在成就伟业还是明哲保身之间进行抉择。 — 无畏战士战行者

card_text.english: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Move that unit's allied neighbors to random other lanes.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合晕眩一个阻挡友方红色英雄的单位，将该单位的友方近邻移至其他随机兵线。

english.CardText_10293: [g:405[Stun]] a [g:607[unit]] blocking an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] this round. Move that [g:607[unit]]'s [g:601[allied neighbors]] to random other lanes.
english.CardLore_10293: I've seen many hunters in my day. Each one bold. And strong. And fearless. Fearless that is, until they realize they're not the Apex Predator... and then they run like the cowards they are.— Beastmaster, Apex Predator

schinese.CardText_10293: 在本回合[g:607[晕眩]]一个阻挡[color:red[友方红色[g:0[英雄]]]]的[g:405[单位]]，将该[g:607[单位]]的[g:601[友方近邻]]移至其他随机兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10293: 我曾经见识过很多猎手。每一个都很勇敢、强壮、无所畏惧，直到他们意识到自己并不是金字塔顶端的猎食者……然后，他们就会像懦夫一样仓皇而逃。— 金字塔顶端的猎食者兽王

card_text.english: Give a unit "Deal 2 piercing damage to this unit before the action phase" until it dies.
card_text.schinese: 施加于一个单位，使其获得“行动阶段前，对此单位造成2透甲伤害”，直至其死亡为止。

english.CardText_10294: Give a [g:607[unit]] "Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:607[unit]] [g:200[before the action phase]]" until it dies.
english.CardEffect_10294_0: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:607[unit]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
english.CardModification_10294_0: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to this [g:607[unit]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
english.CardLore_10294: In time, all things will die... I just like to do my part to speed up the process. — Viper, Lethal Fangs

schinese.CardText_10294: 施加于一个[g:607[单位]]，使其获得“[g:200[行动阶段前]]，对此[g:607[单位]]造成2[g:508[透甲]]伤害”，直至其死亡为止。

schinese.CardLore_10294: 世间万物最终都难逃一死……我只是喜欢尽自己的一份力，加快这个流程。— 致命毒牙冥界亚龙

card_text.english: Modify the enemy tower with -1 Mana.
card_text.schinese: 修改敌方塔，使其-1魔力。

english.CardLore_10295: Many different types of wizards fall under my care in the Tyler Estate. I do not bother to learn their stories or their crimes... if the Quorum has sent them to me they are to be treated in the same manner. Harshly. — Silencer, Warden of the Tyler Estate

schinese.CardLore_10295: 在泰勒庄园，各路巫师都归我管辖。我对他们的背景或罪状毫无兴趣……只要是评议会送来的人，我一视同仁——绝不宽待。— 泰勒庄园守卫沉默术士

card_text.english: Choose an allied red hero. Deal 2 damage to its enemy neighbors and give them -2 Attack this round.
card_text.schinese: 选择一名友方红色英雄，在本回合对其敌方近邻造成2伤害和-2攻击。

english.CardText_10296: Choose an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]]. Deal 2 damage to its [g:600[enemy neighbors]] and give them -2 [g:509[Attack]] this round.
english.CardLore_10296: I was nervous about following the Society of Likeminded Keenfolk to Roseleaf... Sniper had a lot of rules. Rules like 'we can't stop to cut down every tree'. But when he saw the Treants marching towards us, he quickly made an exception. — Timbersaw, Crazed Lumberjack

schinese.CardText_10296: 选择一名[color:red[友方红色[g:0[英雄]]]]，在本回合对其[g:600[敌方近邻]]造成2伤害和-2[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10296: 跟着基恩人共识会前往玫叶城这件事让我很紧张……狙击手有很多规矩。像是“我们没时间停下来砍倒每棵树”。但当他看到树精朝我们走来时，他很快就决定破一次例。— 疯狂的伐木机

card_text.english: Give a hero +3 Armor this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使一名英雄+3护甲。

english.CardLore_10297: Sometimes people ask me 'Mazzie, how do you keep from getting killed if everyone hates you?' And that's when I tell them 'The secret is not letting them stab you to death.' — Mazzie, Full of Good Advice

schinese.CardText_10297: 在本回合使一名[g:0[英雄]]+3[g:504[护甲]]。
schinese.CardLore_10297: 有时候人家会问我：“梅兹，大家这么恨你，你怎么还没死呢？”我说：“秘诀在于不要让人拿刀子捅死。”— 总有好建议的梅兹

card_text.english: Give three random cards in opponent's hand +3 Lock.
card_text.schinese: 使对手的三张随机手牌+3锁定。

english.CardText_10298: Give three random cards in opponent's hand +3 [g:407[Lock]].
english.CardLore_10298: In Claszureme, time is like water... nourishing, beautiful to behold in its various forms... and endlessly fun to play in. — Faceless Void, Shaper of Time

schinese.CardText_10298: 使对手的三张随机手牌+3[g:407[锁定]]。
schinese.CardLore_10298: 在超维视界，时间就像水一样……滋养万物，各种形态美不胜收……而在其中玩耍更是乐趣无穷。— 时间雕塑者虚空假面

card_text.english: Modify a unit with "This unit's allied neighbors have +2 Armor."
card_text.schinese: 修改一个单位，使其获得“此单位的友方近邻+2护甲”。

english.CardLore_10299: Ilexa has no idea how important she will be in the days to come. She must be protected at all costs. — Magnus to the Prowlers

schinese.CardLore_10299: 依蕾莎并不知道，日后自己会有多重要。我们必须不惜一切代价保护她。— 马格纳斯命令潜行者

card_text.english: Modify a hero with +2 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 修改一名英雄，使其+2攻击。

english.CardLore_10300: The ability to successfully kill someone that wants to kill you is a life skill everyone should have. Even Goodkind. — Axe, Proud Teacher

schinese.CardLore_10300: 有能力杀死那些想要杀你的人，是每个人都该有的生存技能。这能力小古也该要有。— 自豪的老师斧王

card_text.english: Modify two random cards in opponent's hand with " Deal 6 damage to a random allied tower in any lane."
card_text.schinese: 修改对手的两张随机手牌，使其获得“对任意兵线上的一座随机友方塔造成6伤害”。

english.CardModification_10302_0: [g:608[□]] Deal 6 damage to a random allied [g:2[tower]] in any lane.
english.CardLore_10302: I wouldn't go so far as to say that there are some places that even the Jasper Circle can't reach, just that sometimes courting betrayal is significantly easier. — Lorlin Lasan, Problem Solver

schinese.CardText_10302: [g:401[修改]]对手的两张随机手牌，使其获得“[g:608[□]]对任意兵线上的一座随机友方[g:2[塔]]造成6伤害”。
schinese.CardModification_10302_0: [g:608[□]]对任意兵线上的一座随机友方[g:2[塔]]造成6伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10302: 我还不至于说有些地方连碧玉会都鞭长莫及，只是说在内部煽动造反会容易得多。— 善于解决问题的洛琳·拉山

card_text.english: Move a creep to a random other lane.
card_text.schinese: 将一名小兵移至另一条随机兵线。

english.CardText_10303: Move a [g:1[creep]] to a random other lane.
english.CardLore_10303: It's the rule of nature: there is always something stronger and deadlier than you. Some people need to be reminded of that truth. — Magnus on Jungle Survival

schinese.CardText_10303: 将一名[g:1[小兵]]移至另一条随机兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10303: 自然的规律就是如此。总会有比你更为强大、更为致命的存在。需要提醒一下某些人了。— 马格纳斯谈丛林生存

card_text.english: Condemn all enemy improvements.
card_text.schinese: 惩处所有敌方强化。

english.CardLore_10305: Sometimes I think Sniper doesn't really want to be my friend, he just wants me on his side so I won't destroy everything he loves. — Timbersaw, Paranoid Keen

schinese.CardLore_10305: 有时候我觉得狙击手并不想和我做朋友，他只是希望我站在他这边，这样我才不会毁掉他所爱的一切。— 基恩人偏执狂伐木机

card_text.english: Condemn an improvement.  Draw a card.
card_text.schinese: 惩处一个强化。抽一张牌。

english.CardLore_10306: Everyone likes to think they build things that last, but if you give the Keen enough time, we'll figure out how to destroy anything. — Timbersaw, Founding Member of the S.O.L.K.

schinese.CardLore_10306: 每个人都希望自己建造的东西能永久不灭，但如果给基恩人足够的时间，我们会找出摧毁任何东西的办法。— 基共会创始成员伐木机

card_text.english: Draw 2 cards.
card_text.schinese: 抽两张牌。

english.CardLore_10307: The Oracle claims to see every eventuality; if true such a man could be a powerful ally... or at the very least a foe worth testing myself against. — Dark Seer ponders the future

schinese.CardLore_10307: 神谕者自称能够看到一切结局；如果是真的，那他会是个强大的盟友……或至少是个值得一战的对手。— 黑暗贤者思索未来

card_text.english: Discard a random card. Condemn a hero.
card_text.schinese: 舍弃一张随机卡牌，惩处一名英雄。

english.CardLore_10308: I'm immoral, not a sadist. If I am asked to kill you it will be clean and quick. — Phantom Assassin, Efficient Killer

schinese.CardText_10308: 舍弃一张随机卡牌，[g:408[惩处]]一名[g:0[英雄]]。
schinese.CardLore_10308: 道德对我没有意义，但我并不以虐杀为乐。如果我要杀你，你会死得干净利落。— 杀戮高手幻影刺客

card_text.english: Deal 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower before the action phase.
card_text.schinese: 行动阶段前，对敌方塔造成2透甲伤害。

english.CardText_10310: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
english.CardEffect_10310_0: Deal 2 [g:508[piercing]] damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] [g:200[before the action phase]].
english.CardLore_10310: The Bronze Legion weren't supposed be in Roseleaf, but it doesn't matter... we were going to have to face them eventually. On one hand it's a shame. A warrior like Tresdin deserves more than dying in some backwater vhoul city. On the other, perhaps it is a mercy that she will be spared from seeing her beloved city burn. — Vreth, Oglodi Artillerist

schinese.CardText_10310: [g:200[行动阶段前]]，对敌方[g:2[塔]]造成2[g:508[透甲]]伤害。
schinese.CardEffect_10310_0: [g:200[行动阶段前]]，对敌方[g:2[塔]]造成2[g:508[透甲]]伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10310: 古铜军团不该在玫叶城出现的，但是没关系；跟他们狭路相逢本来就是迟早的事情。一方面觉得惋惜，像特蕾丝汀这种战士就算死，也不该死在豺狼人的穷乡僻壤。另一方面，让她不用亲眼目睹心爱之地化为灰烬或许是一种慈悲。— 高地人炮手威瑞斯

card_text.english: Modify allied creeps with +2 Attack and +1 Armor.
card_text.schinese: 修改友方小兵，使其+2攻击和+1护甲。

english.CardLore_10311: I'll never forget the first day of the rebellion. Tresdin sent me to collect rations from the farmers of Roseleaf... supplies in case the Red Mist siege would be prolonged... but it was a lean year for those farmers. I reported what they could spare, but Tresdin decided it wasn't enough, and so she instructed her thugs to take what they needed by force...after all, 'it was for their own good.' Well when her people arrived they didn't find cowering farmers. They found an army that I will lead until my dying day. The men, women and pups of Roseleaf deserve to live their lives free of Stonehall's grip. And while the price of their freedom will be blood, it is a price we are all willing to pay. — Rix, Rabble-Rouser

schinese.CardLore_10311: 我永远不会忘记叛军成立的那一天。特蕾丝汀派我前往玫叶城，向农夫征收粮食，以防红雾持续围城的可能性……但那一年是荒年。我上报了农夫能拿出来的份额，但特蕾丝汀觉得太少，于是命令手下那些恶棍强行抢夺他们需要的粮食……她说：“这是为了他们好。”不过当她的手下抵达时，看到的不是一群畏头缩尾的农夫，而是一支由我率领的部队。我将带领他们，直到我咽下最后一口气。玫叶城的男女老幼有权选择他们想要的生活，不再受石堂城摆布。纵使这份自由得用鲜血来换，我们也心甘情愿。— 揭竿起义者瑞克斯

card_text.english: Deal 2 damage to each enemy creep.
card_text.schinese: 对每名敌方小兵各造成2伤害。

english.CardLore_10312: Soaring through the air is not just a liberating experience, it is also an effective way to dispatch one's enemies. — Skywrath Mage, Flying Free

schinese.CardText_10312: 对每名敌方[g:1[小兵]]各造成2伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10312: 空中翱翔不仅是种无拘无束的享受，也是了结敌人的有效方式。— 自由飞翔的天怒法师

card_text.english: Give a red hero +4 Attack this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使一名红色英雄+4攻击。

english.CardLore_10313: Courage is not what makes a hunter great. It's patience. — Warrunner speaks to the hunters of Marrowfell

schinese.CardText_10313: 在本回合使一名[color:red[红色[g:0[英雄]]]]+4[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10313: 让猎手变得伟大的不是勇气，而是耐心。— 战行者对断骨猎手的发言

card_text.english: Deal 2 damage to the enemy tower for each of its improvements.
card_text.schinese: 敌方塔每有一个强化就受2伤害。

english.CardText_10314: Deal 2 damage to the enemy [g:2[tower]] for each of its [g:3[improvements]].
english.CardLore_10314: Slark and I go back a long time. He's a bastard, but he's my kind of bastard. — Lorlin Lasan, Morally Flexible

schinese.CardText_10314: 敌方[g:2[塔]]每有一个[g:3[强化]]就受2伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10314: 斯拉克与我是老相识了。他是个混蛋，不过是我中意的那种混蛋。— 识时务的洛琳·拉山

card_text.english: Condemn all units.
card_text.schinese: 惩处所有单位。

english.CardLore_10315: It is wise to fear the power of the Ancients... — Kanna, Seeker of Matricide

schinese.CardLore_10315: 畏惧遗迹的力量是明智的……— 意图弑母的卡娜

card_text.english: Give a hero and its allied neighbors Pierce this round. Draw a card.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使一名英雄及其友方近邻获得透甲。抽一张牌。

english.CardText_10316: Give a [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] [g:611[Pierce]] this round. Draw a card.
english.CardLore_10316: Anything is killable. The only question is if you can live long enough to spot its weakness. — Warrunner speaks to the hunters of Marrowfell

schinese.CardText_10316: 在本回合使一名[g:0[英雄]]及其[g:601[友方近邻]]获得[g:611[透甲]]。抽一张牌。
schinese.CardLore_10316: 没有什么对手是杀不死的。唯一的问题是你能不能活到找出对方死穴的那一刻。— 战行者对断骨猎手的发言

card_text.english: Modify enemy heroes with -2 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 修改敌方英雄，使其-2攻击。

english.CardLore_10317: Scree'auk has given me the power to exact my revenge... and it will be slow and agonizing. — Shendelzare, the Vengeful Spirit

schinese.CardLore_10317: 丝奎奥克赐予了我进行复仇的力量……我会让敌人求生不得求死不能。— 复仇之魂仙德尔莎

Deal 3 damage to a unit. Repeat 7 times:  Deal 3 damage to a random unit to its left or right.

Get initiative.

对一个单位造成3伤害。重复7次：对其左侧或右侧的一个随机单位造成3伤害。

获得先手。

english.CardText_10318:
Deal 3 damage to a [g:607[unit]]. Repeat 7 times: [g:608[□]] Deal 3 damage to a random [g:607[unit]] to its left or right.

[color:quick[[g:604[▢ Get initiative]].]]
english.CardLore_10318: Could I simply cast out a wave of frost? Certainly. But flash freezing your enemies isn't nearly as satisfying as watching them panic before their impending death. — Lich on savoring the moment

schinese.CardText_10318:
对一个[g:607[单位]]造成3伤害。重复7次：[g:608[□]]对其左侧或右侧的一个随机[g:607[单位]]造成3伤害。

[color:quick[[g:604[▢获得先手]]。]]
schinese.CardLore_10318: 我能直接放出一波冰霜吗？当然可以。但看着敌人为逼近的死亡惊恐不已，比瞬间冰冻他们有趣多了。— 享受当下的巫妖

card_text.english: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage to allies in all lanes.
card_text.schinese: 抽两张牌。对所有兵线上的友方单位造成2伤害。

english.CardText_10319: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage to allies in all lanes.
english.CardLore_10319: My mother speaks of the Ancients desires. Order. Peace. Devotion. But she's wrong. The ancients demand one thing, and that's blood. — Kanna, Daughter of Prellex

schinese.CardText_10319: 抽两张牌。对所有兵线上的友方单位造成2伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10319: 我的母亲曾经说过遗迹要的是什么——秩序、和平、虔诚。但她错了，遗迹只想要一种东西，那就是鲜血。— 普瑞蕾斯之女卡娜

card_text.english: Double your gold.
card_text.schinese: 你的金钱加倍。

english.CardLore_10322: Revtel is my favorite place to do business. The morals are lose, but their contracts are fair; whenever I took a job from The Brass Herald, Lord Sunbreeze, or Kwerthias I knew they'd make good. Kwerthias... ya know, as a general rule you don't make too many friends in my line of work but... he was one of the good ones. I'm sorry he's dead. — in which Gondar remembers a fallen friend

schinese.CardLore_10322: 我最喜欢在瑞文泰尔做生意。这里的人不讲什么仁义道德，但他们的条件都开得不错。每次从黄铜先锋、晴风领主、或是奎堤亚斯那里接工作，我就知道肯定不会差。奎堤亚斯……你懂的，干我们这行的规矩就是不能在工作中交太多朋友，不过……他是个好人。他死了真是可惜。— 刚铎回忆逝去的好友

card_text.english: Deal damage to each enemy equal to the number of enemies.
card_text.schinese: 对每个敌人造成伤害，数值为敌人的数量。

english.CardText_10323: Deal damage to each enemy equal to the number of enemies.
english.CardLore_10323: Prellex is raising an army to destroy her daughter, but I won't allow that to happen. Let them come in droves... no one will get past me. — Earthshaker, Protector of Kanna

schinese.CardText_10323: 对每个敌人造成伤害，数值为敌人的数量。
schinese.CardLore_10323: 普瑞蕾斯正在招兵买马，想要毁掉她的女儿。但我不会容許这样的事情发生。让他们放马过来吧……没有人过得了我这一关。— 卡娜的保护者撼地者

card_text.english: Give a unit in any lane +3 Armor until end of its next combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 使任意兵线上的一个单位+3护甲，直至其下个战斗阶段结束为止。

english.CardText_10324: Give a [g:607[unit]] in any lane +3 [g:504[Armor]] until end of its next [g:203[combat phase]].
english.CardLore_10324: I remember when the Vhoul first made their home in roseleaf. At the time they were not much more than feral beasts, barely worth the treants notice. But as the generations came and went, my cousins became fascinated as they watched a culture grow before their very eyes so when the Vhoul named their city after my cousins as a sign of respect, well... that fascination turned into a sort of love. And so while the Treants of roseleaf try not to directly interfere with the goings on of the Vhoul, they always try to help from afar. — Treant Protector, Branches of Iron

schinese.CardText_10324: 使任意兵线上的一个[g:607[单位]]+3[g:504[护甲]]，直至其下个[g:203[战斗阶段]]结束为止。
schinese.CardLore_10324: 我还记得豺狼人最早在玫叶城安家的时候。那时他们不过是些野兽，几乎不值得树精注意。但随着豺狼人一代代繁衍生息，我的表亲们目睹了他们的文化在眼前发展壮大，对他们越来越着迷。所以当豺狼人以我表亲们的名字来命名他们的城市，以示尊敬时，嗯……这种迷恋变成了一种爱。因此，虽然玫叶的树精尽量不直接干预豺狼人的行为，但却总是远远地关照他们。— 钢铁树枝树精卫士

card_text.english: Summon a Hound of War for every damaged unit.
card_text.schinese: 每有一个受伤的单位，就召唤一头战争猎犬。

english.CardText_10325: [g:409[Summon]] a [[Hound of War]] for every damaged [g:607[unit]].
english.CardLore_10325: There's something particularly satisfying about watching Radiant zealots run for their lives. — Kanna, The Cruelty of Youth

schinese.CardText_10325: 每有一个受伤的[g:607[单位]]，就[g:409[召唤]]一头[[战争猎犬]]。
schinese.CardLore_10325: 看着天辉的狂热信徒四散逃命，真令人心满意足。— 年轻无情的卡娜

card_text.english: Proceed to the combat phase.
card_text.schinese: 直接进入战斗阶段。

english.CardLore_10326: Axe doesn't know much about magic except that you have to punch it. — Axe, Fan of Simple Solutions

schinese.CardLore_10326: 斧王不懂什么是魔法，只知道用拳头解决问题。— 简单方案爱好者斧王

card_text.english: Modify a red hero with "After you play a non-item card costing 2 or less, modify this hero with +2 Health."
card_text.schinese: 修改一名红色英雄，使其获得“每打出一张魔力消耗不超过2的非物品卡后，修改此英雄，使其+2生命”。

english.CardEffect_10327_0: After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +2 [g:510[Health]].
english.CardModification_10327_0: After you play a non-[g:5[item]] card costing 2 or less, [g:401[modify]] this [g:0[hero]] with +2 [g:510[Health]].
english.CardLore_10327: The world is a like a 280 lbs belligerent walrus man... it's not just gonna try to beat you down, it's gonna try to beat you while you're down. So when that metaphorical, or in my case very literal, walrus man starts stalkin' towards ya... you only got one option: pick yourself up and punch that bastard in the face. — Bristleback, 5 Pint Philosopher

schinese.CardText_10327: [g:401[修改]]一名[color:red[红色[g:0[英雄]]]]，使其获得“每打出一张魔力消耗不超过2的非[g:5[物品]]卡后，[g:401[修改]]此[g:0[英雄]]，使其+2[g:510[生命]]”。

schinese.CardLore_10327: 这个世界就像一个三百斤重的海象人，不但要把你撂倒，还趁你倒在地上时继续狠揍你。对你来说这可能只是个比方，但对我来说，还真有这么一个海象人。当他开始朝你走来的时候，你就只有一个办法：打起精神，朝那混蛋脸上来一拳。— 五桶酒思想家钢背兽

card_text.english: Choose an allied black hero. Choose another unit in any lane. They battle each other.
card_text.schinese: 选择一名友方黑色英雄和任意兵线上的另一个单位，让双方战斗。

english.CardText_10328: Choose an [color:black[allied black [g:0[hero]]]]. Choose another [g:607[unit]] in any lane. They [g:400[battle]] each other.
english.CardLore_10328: If you want someone dead, Slark is a wonderful gentleman to know. — Lorlin Lasan, Kobold Spymaster

schinese.CardText_10328: 选择一名[color:black[友方黑色[g:0[英雄]]]]和任意兵线上的另一个[g:607[单位]]，让双方[g:400[战斗]]。
schinese.CardLore_10328: 你想要谁的命的话，那就该去结识一下这位叫斯拉克的非凡绅士。— 狗头人王牌间谍洛琳·拉山

card_text.english: Modify a red hero with +4 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 修改一名红色英雄，使其+4攻击。

english.CardLore_10330: I am not yet strong enough to avenge my father's execution. But in time... I will be. — Sven, Preparing for Vengeance

schinese.CardText_10330: [g:401[修改]]一名[color:red[红色[g:0[英雄]]]]，使其+4[g:509[攻击]]。
schinese.CardLore_10330: 我的力量还不足以为父亲被处刑报仇。但假以时日……那一天会到来的。— 准备复仇的斯温

card_text.english: Spend all your gold. Repeat one time for each gold spent:  Deal 4 damage to a random ally or enemy.
card_text.schinese: 消耗你所有的金钱。每消耗1金钱，重复一次：对一个随机友方单位或敌人造成4伤害。

english.CardText_10331: Spend all your gold. Repeat one time for each gold spent: [g:608[□]] Deal 4 damage to a random ally or enemy.
english.CardLore_10331: The coin of man is useless to me, but instrumental in their own undoing. — in which Outworld Devourer decides to take things literally

schinese.CardText_10331: 消耗你所有的金钱。每消耗1金钱，重复一次：[g:608[□]]对一个随机友方单位或敌人造成4伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10331: 人类的货币对我毫无意义，却是为他们自己带来毁灭的器具。— 殁境神蚀者决定说到做到

card_text.english: Give a black hero +8 Attack this round. Choose a combat target for it.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使一名黑色英雄+8攻击。为其选择一个战斗目标。

english.CardText_10332: Give a [color:black[black [g:0[hero]]]] +8 [g:509[Attack]] this round. Choose a combat target for it.
english.CardLore_10332: My task in Revtel has set many events into motion. A new Merchant King will rise to stand alongside Sunbreeze and the Brass Herald. The Relic Slayer has grown bolder in Iron Fog... and the Veiled Sisterhood is now at war with Revtel... but all of this was seen by the Veiled Oracles and all is as it needs to be. — Phantom Assassin, Kingslayer

schinese.CardText_10332: 在本回合使一名[color:black[黑色[g:0[英雄]]]]+8[g:509[攻击]]。为其选择一个战斗目标。
schinese.CardLore_10332: 我在瑞文泰尔的任务触发了许多事件。新的商王将与晴风和黄铜先锋并驾齐驱。铁雾的圣物杀手越来越肆无忌惮……魅影之纱姐妹会已经与瑞文泰尔开战……但魅纱神谕者已经预见了这一切，事情正按照我们的期望发展。— 弑君者幻影刺客

card_text.english: Give your tower +3 Mana this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使你的塔+3魔力。

english.CardLore_10334: Weeping Rose is shrouded in perpetual nightfall, a means for the Quorum to harness the power of the stars. — Silencer welcomes a visitor to Weeping Rose

schinese.CardText_10334: 在本回合使你的[g:2[塔]]+3[g:511[魔力]]。
schinese.CardLore_10334: 永恒夜幕笼罩着悲玫城，这是评议团为了完全掌控星辰之力而刻意安排的。— 沉默术士欢迎前来悲玫城的访客

card_text.english: Summon two Melee Creeps into any lane.
card_text.schinese: 召唤两名近战小兵至任意兵线。

english.CardLore_10335: There is no place to hide from the wrath of the Dire. — Kanna, Vengeful Daughter

schinese.CardText_10335: [g:409[召唤]]两名[[近战小兵]]至任意兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10335: 没人能躲过夜魇的怒火。— 充满仇恨的女儿卡娜

card_text.english: Summon a Melee Creep into any lane.
card_text.schinese: 召唤一名近战小兵至任意兵线。

english.CardLore_10336: Prellex's army grows larger by the day. For now they're disorganized, but I know my mother. It won't take long before they're a threat. — Kanna strategizes with her allies

schinese.CardText_10336: [g:409[召唤]]一名[[近战小兵]]至任意兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10336: 普瑞蕾斯的军队日益壮大。现在他们的组织还不严明，但我了解我的母亲。用不了多久，他们就会构成真正的威胁。— 卡娜与盟友讨论战略

card_text.english: Give allies Damage Immunity this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使友方单位获得伤害免疫。

english.CardLore_10338: The Allseeing one will never forsake His agents. — Omniknight, Soldier of the Divine

schinese.CardText_10338: 在本回合使友方单位获得[g:507[伤害免疫]]。
schinese.CardLore_10338: 全视者绝不会遗弃他的使者。— 神圣战士全知骑士

card_text.english: Silence an enemy hero and its allied neighbors this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合沉默一名敌方英雄及其友方近邻。

english.CardText_10339: [g:406[Silence]] an enemy [g:0[hero]] and its [g:601[allied neighbors]] this round.
english.CardLore_10339: Never take victory for granted... the moment you assume there's nothing an enemy can do to stop you, is the moment you're most likely to lose.— Drow Ranger, Spoiler

schinese.CardText_10339: 在本回合[g:406[沉默]]一名敌方[g:0[英雄]]及其[g:601[友方近邻]]。
schinese.CardLore_10339: 骄兵必败……当你觉得对方已无计可施的时候，正是你要吃败仗的时候。— 知晓结局的卓尔游侠

card_text.english: Fully heal each ally. Give allies Damage Immunity this round.
card_text.schinese: 完整治疗所有友方单位，在本回合使其获得伤害免疫。

english.CardText_10340: Fully heal each ally. Give allies [g:507[Damage Immunity]] this round.
english.CardLore_10340: The Knights of the Fold gave me a fresh start and a new life. It will do the same for you was well. — Chen, Converter of Many

schinese.CardText_10340: 完整治疗所有友方单位，在本回合使其获得[g:507[伤害免疫]]。
schinese.CardLore_10340: 投奔教会骑士让我重获新生，这样做也会给你一个全新的开始。— 感化大众的陈

card_text.english: Choose an allied red hero and another unit. They battle each other.
card_text.schinese: 选择一名友方红色英雄和另一个单位，让双方战斗。

english.CardText_10341: Choose an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] and another [g:607[unit]]. They [g:400[battle]] each other.
english.CardLore_10341: How many more of our people need to die? Let's just end this here and now. — Legion Commander, The battle of Roseleaf

schinese.CardText_10341: 选择一名[color:red[友方红色[g:0[英雄]]]]和另一个[g:607[单位]]，让双方[g:400[战斗]]。
schinese.CardLore_10341: 还要让多少我们的族人白白死去？我们就在这里做个了结吧。— 玫叶之战军团指挥官

card_text.english: Choose an allied hero. It taunts. Choose a combat target for it.
card_text.schinese: 选择一名友方英雄，使其嘲讽，为其选择一个战斗目标。

english.CardText_10342: Choose an allied [g:0[hero]]. It [g:403[taunts]]. Choose a combat target for it.
english.CardLore_10342: It takes a lot to get me mad- ok that's a lie, I'm always mad. It takes a lot to make me wanna fight someone- yeah, that's not true either. I- oh to hell with it, let's be honest I like punching people. — Bristleback, Lover of Violence

schinese.CardText_10342: 选择一名友方[g:0[英雄]]，使其[g:403[嘲讽]]，为其选择一个战斗目标。
schinese.CardLore_10342: 想让我发火没那么容易——好吧，这是瞎掰，我火气大得很。要让我干一架没那么容易——好吧，这也是胡扯。我——欸，去他的，我说实话吧，我就喜欢揍人。— 暴力爱好者钢背兽

card_text.english: Give allied heroes +4 Cleave this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合使所有友方英雄+4顺势。

english.CardLore_10344: Kunkka can hide on his boat all he likes... it won't be enough to save him. — Tidehunter, Kunkka's Rival

schinese.CardText_10344: 在本回合使所有友方[g:0[英雄]]+4[g:502[顺势]]。
schinese.CardLore_10344: 昆卡大可躲在他的船上……反正这也救不了他。— 昆卡的宿敌潮汐猎人

card_text.english: Summon two Roseleaf Walls.
card_text.schinese: 召唤两道玫叶墙。

english.CardLore_10347: I protect the forest, and in turn the forest protects me. — Enchantress, Soul of Spring

schinese.CardLore_10347: 我保护森林，反过来，森林也会保护我。— 回春之魂魅惑魔女

card_text.english: Modify a green hero with "Allies have +2 Regeneration."
card_text.schinese: 修改一名绿色英雄，使其获得“友方单位+2恢复”。

english.CardLore_10348: Once I doubted my faith; but no longer. The All Seeing one has chosen me to be its champion and I will not let the Omniscience down. — Omniknight, Rewarded For His Faith

schinese.CardText_10348: [g:401[修改]]一名[color:green[绿色[g:0[英雄]]]]，使其获得“友方单位+2[g:505[恢复]]”。
schinese.CardLore_10348: 曾经我怀疑自己的信仰，如今我深信不疑。全视者选我做他的卫士，我绝不会辜负全知神教。— 信仰得到回报的全知骑士

english.CardLore_10349: Tusk's breath was a mix of stale beer and raw fish, but I wasn't about to back down... no... I was just getting started. — Bristleback, No Quit In Him

schinese.CardText_10349: [g:401[修改]]一名[color:red[红色[g:0[英雄]]]]，使其获得“每打出一张魔力消耗不超过2的非[g:5[物品]]卡后，[g:401[修改]]此[g:0[英雄]]，使其+1[g:509[攻击]]”。

schinese.CardLore_10349: 巨牙海民的嘴巴里一股子过期臭啤酒混上死鱼烂虾的味道，但我不会退缩……不会的……我才刚刚开始呢。— 决不放弃的钢背兽

card_text.english: Stun a unit blocking an allied red hero this round. Deal 2 damage to that unit.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合晕眩一个阻挡友方红色英雄的单位，并对该单位造成2伤害。

english.CardText_10350: [g:405[Stun]] a [g:607[unit]] blocking an [color:red[allied red [g:0[hero]]]] this round. Deal 2 damage to that [g:607[unit]].
english.CardLore_10350: There are few things more annoying than fighting a cat man that makes copies of himself. Every time you think you kill the last one, there’s always another one behind you. — Axe, Easily Fooled

schinese.CardText_10350: 在本回合[g:405[晕眩]]一个阻挡[color:red[友方红色[g:0[英雄]]]]的[g:607[单位]]，并对该[g:607[单位]]造成2伤害。
schinese.CardLore_10350: 很少有比跟会分身的猫人打架更烦人的事。每当你以为已经干掉最后一个的时候，总会有另一个从你的身后冒出来。— 容易上当的斧王

card_text.english: Deal 6 damage to the enemy tower.
card_text.schinese: 对敌方塔造成6伤害。

english.CardLore_10352: Be grateful you only annoyed me mortal, had you offended me the results would be far more... interesting. — Zeus, 'Merciful' God

schinese.CardLore_10352: 凡人，你该庆幸我只对你感到厌烦，如果你冒犯了我，结局就会更……有趣了。— “仁慈”神宙斯

card_text.english: Deal 20 damage to the enemy tower.
card_text.schinese: 对敌方塔造成20伤害。

english.CardLore_10353: Some mistake my taking on the mortal coil as a sign that I have grown weaker. Every now and again I like to remind the world that that isn't the case. My wife would say that cratering a city is overkill. She's probably right. But I've always been a fan of grand gestures. — Zeus, Poor Impulse Control

card_text.schinese: 对每个敌人造成4伤害。

english.CardLore_10412: Zeus destroyed a building so I destroyed an army... I thought the matter was settled but then he decided to go throw a temper tantrum and crater a city. — Storm Spirit, Sore Loser

schinese.CardLore_10412: 宙斯毁了一座建筑，所以我毁了一支军队……我原以为这就能把争论给解决了，谁知他却气急败坏地把一座城市给打成了陨石坑。— 输不起的风暴之灵

card_text.english: Give allies +2 Siege this round. Allies change their combat target to the unit or tower across from them.

english.CardText_10413: Give allies +2 [g:501[Siege]] this round. Allies change their combat target to the [g:607[unit]] or [g:2[tower]] across from them.
english.CardLore_10413: There is a time for tactics, and there is a time for conviction. — Sorla Khan, Proud Oglodi

schinese.CardText_10413: 在本回合使友方单位+2[g:501[攻城]]。将所有友方单位的战斗目标改为其面对的[g:607[单位]]或[g:2[塔]]。
schinese.CardLore_10413: 有时候靠的是策略，有时候靠的则是坚定的信念。— 骄傲的高地人索尔拉可汗

card_text.english: Modify a black hero with +3 Siege.
card_text.schinese: 修改一名黑色英雄，使其+3攻城。

english.CardLore_10415: Convincing The Antimage to work with the Tyler Estate wasn't an easy task, but it was worth it. He is...exuberant in his work. — Silencer, on working with The Anti-Mage

schinese.CardText_10415: [g:401[修改]]一名[color:black[黑色[g:0[英雄]]]]，使其+3[g:501[攻城]]。
schinese.CardLore_10415: 说服敌法师与泰勒庄园合作并非易事，但十分值得。他……对工作非常热心。— 沉默术士对与敌法师合作一事的看法

card_text.english: Give a hero +10 Bounty until it dies.
card_text.schinese: 使一名英雄+10赏金，直至其死亡为止。

english.CardLore_10416: It's not always honest work, but it's certainly lucrative. — Bounty Hunter, Professional Tracker

schinese.CardText_10416: 使一名[g:0[英雄]]+10[g:500[赏金]]，直至其死亡为止。
schinese.CardLore_10416: 这些活大部份都不太光彩，但油水不会少。— 追踪专家赏金猎人

card_text.english: Summon two Centaur Hunters into any lane.
card_text.schinese: 召唤两名半人马猎手至任意兵线。

english.CardLore_10417: There are no words to describe the anticipation you feel the moment before you descend on your prey. — Warrunner, Leader of the Hunt

schinese.CardText_10417: [g:409[召唤]]两名[[半人马猎手]]至任意兵线。
schinese.CardLore_10417: 在袭击猎物前那种希冀期待的感觉，是言语无法形容的。— 狩猎领袖战行者

card_text.english: Choose a unit. It taunts.
card_text.schinese: 选择一个单位，使其嘲讽。

english.CardLore_10418: The best way to survive in this world is knowing who you can shove in front of the town guards so you can make a quick getaway. — Meepo, Always Skipping the Check

schinese.CardText_10418: 选择一个[g:607[单位]]，使其[g:403[嘲讽]]。
schinese.CardLore_10418: 在这个世界上，保命的万全之策是知道关键时候可以把谁弄出来当挡箭牌，然后脚底抹油，溜之大吉。— 总是逃之夭夭的的米波

card_text.english: Modify a unit with -2 Armor.
card_text.schinese: 修改一个单位，使其-2护甲。

english.CardLore_10419: It's not gonna score points with the ladies, but when it comes to winning a fight I'll take every advantage I can get. — Bristleback, Dirty Fighter

schinese.CardLore_10419: 这玩意不能帮你赢得姑娘的芳心，但要是想打赢场架，我能用的都要用上。— 黑拳钢背兽

card_text.english: Silence a unit this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合沉默一个单位。

english.CardLore_10420: The powerful would have the weak be silent. To accept the status quo. To bend the knee. To accept their lot in life. For too long I was complicit in Stonehall’s grab for power. It ends today. I will be a voice for my people, and I will not be silenced. — Rix, Ex-Bronze Legion

schinese.CardText_10420: 在本回合[g:406[沉默]]一个[g:607[单位]]。
schinese.CardLore_10420: 在强者面前，弱者只有沉默。接受现实，屈膝投降，接受命运。很久以来，我都是石堂城的共犯，助他们夺取权力。而今天，一切都将结束。我会为人民发声，不再俯首称臣。— 古铜军团前成员瑞克斯

card_text.english: Modify a hero with -2 Attack.
card_text.schinese: 修改一名英雄，使其-2攻击。

english.CardLore_10421: The best part of making your enemy limp away is that you really get to take the time to savor their last moments. — Pugna, Delights in Malice

schinese.CardLore_10421: 把敌人打得一瘸一拐的最大好处，就是可以慢慢欣赏他们垂死挣扎的样子。— 幸灾乐祸的帕格纳

card_text.english: Stun an enemy this round and stun allied heroes in all lanes this round.
card_text.schinese: 在本回合晕眩一个敌人并晕眩所有兵线上的友方英雄。

english.CardText_10422: [g:405[Stun]] an enemy this round and [g:405[stun]] allied [g:0[heroes]] in all lanes this round.
english.CardLore_10422: Pierpont always warns me about 'dabbling with things you don't understand'. Most of the time he's being a sanctimonious bastard... unfortunately sometimes he's right. Well, mostly right, I mean I've never died permanently. Ya know, now that I think about it, he's basically always just being a sanctimonious bastard. — Vanessa, Pierpont's Foil

schinese.CardText_10422: 在本回合[g:405[晕眩]]一名敌人并[g:405[晕眩]]所有兵线上的友方[g:0[英雄]]。
schinese.CardLore_10422: 皮尔庞特老是警告我说“不要去搅和你不懂的事情”。大部分时间他是个假圣人真混蛋……但是有时候他是对的。怎么说呢，大概上是对的，毕竟我还没有真的死透。其实现在回想起来，他基本上就是个假圣人真混蛋。 — 皮尔庞特的陪衬凡妮莎

card_text.english: Deal 6 damage to every unit.

english.CardLore_10424: There's a lot things you can say about my sister. Most of them revolve around her being a rage-filled arson machine. — Crystal Maiden calls it like she sees it

schinese.CardLore_10424: 我姐有很多传闻，但大部分都跟她脾气暴躁又爱放火有关。— 实话实说的冰晶圣女

card_text.english: Modify allied heroes with +4 Attack, +4 Armor, +4 Health, +4 Cleave, +4 Retaliate, and +4 Siege.
card_text.schinese: 修改友方英雄，使其+4攻击、+4护甲、+4生命、+4顺势、+4反伤和+4攻城。

english.CardLore_10425: I've written a lot of books about Axe, the most popular of which is easily 'The Roshan Expedition'. Personally I think, 'Red Mist, Red Passion' is better, but people heard 'erotic thriller' and never gave it a chance. — Goodkind, Literary Icon

schinese.CardLore_10425: 我写了许多本关于斧王的书，当中最受欢迎的是《肉山的远征》。我个人更喜欢《红雾激情》，但是许多人一听到“情色惊悚”便退避三舍了。— 文学界的偶像小古

english.CardLore_10536: There are number of things one could say about Zeus. He has a delightful mustache. His physique is chiseled out of marble. And when it comes to two-timing your wife while disguised as a swan, there is no equal. But one thing he is not is 'The God of Thunder'. For I am thunder. And lightning. And wind. And rain. Indeed, I am the tempest itself... and there is no god to whom I bow. — Storm Spirit, Zeus' Rival

schinese.CardLore_10536: 关于宙斯，能说的可不少。他的胡子很可爱，他的体格就像是大理石雕琢而成，当论到变身成天鹅背着老婆出轨，没人比他更行。但有一个误会，那就是他不是“雷神”，因为我才是雷霆，我才是闪电，我才是狂风，我才是暴雨。是的，我才是暴风雨……而我不敬畏任何神。— 宙斯的对手风暴之灵
